(I) 由 \(x = t^2 (t > 0)\), 得 \(t = \sqrt{x}\), 则
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t}
\]
\[
\begin{array}{l} \frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} x ^ {2}} = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x} \left(\frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t}\right) = - \frac {1}{4} x ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} + \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x} \left(\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t}\right) \\ = - \frac {1}{4} x ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} + \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} t ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{\mathrm{d} x} \\ = - \frac {1}{4} x ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} + \frac {1}{4 x} \frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} t ^ {2}} \\ \end{array}
\]
将 \(\frac{\mathrm{dy}}{\mathrm{dx}}, \frac{\mathrm{d}^2y}{\mathrm{dx}^2}, \sqrt{x} = t\) 代入原方程，化简得
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} t ^ {2}} - \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} - 6 y = \mathrm{e} ^ {- t} \tag {①}
\]
（Ⅱ）方程 ① 对应的特征方程为  \( r^{2}-r-6=0 \) ，解得  \( r_{1}=-2, r_{2}=3 \) .
令方程 ① 的特解为 \( y^{*} = t^{0} \cdot A e^{-t} \)，则 \( y^{*'} = -A e^{-t} \)，将 \( y^{*''} = A e^{-t} \) 代入方程 ①，可得 \( A = -\frac{1}{4} \).
故方程 ① 的通解为  \( y = C_{1} e^{-2t} + C_{2} e^{3t} - \frac{1}{4} e^{-t} \) .
原方程的通解为 \( y = C_1 \mathrm{e}^{-2\sqrt{x}} + C_2 \mathrm{e}^{3\sqrt{x}} - \frac{1}{4} \mathrm{e}^{-\sqrt{x}} \).
由 \(\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}y(x) = 0\) ，得 \(C_1 + C_2 - \frac{1}{4} = 0.\)
由 \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}y(x) = 0\) ，得 \(C_2 = 0\) ，故 \(C_1 = \frac{1}{4}, C_2 = 0.\)
所求函数为 \( y(x) = \frac{1}{4}\mathrm{e}^{-2\sqrt{x}} - \frac{1}{4}\mathrm{e}^{-\sqrt{x}} \).

2000027002.analysis_md:
解式 令 \(F(x) = \int_{0}^{x} f(t) \, \mathrm{d}t\)，则 \(F(0) = 0\). 记 \(G(x) = \frac{F(x)}{x}\)，则
\[
\begin{array}{l} G ^ {\prime} (x) = \frac {x F ^ {\prime} (x) - F (x)}{x ^ {2}} = \frac {x F ^ {\prime} (x) - [ F (x) - F (0) ]}{x ^ {2}} \\ = \frac {x F ^ {\prime} (x) - x F ^ {\prime} (\xi)}{x ^ {2}} = \frac {x [ f (x) - f (\xi) ]}{x ^ {2}} \quad (0 <   \xi <   x <   b) \\ \end{array}
\]
由 \(f^{\prime}(x) > 0\) ，知 \(f(x)\) 单调递增，故 \(f(x) > f(\xi)\) ，所以 \(G^{\prime}(x) > 0\) ，从而 \(G(x)\) 单调递增，故
\[
G (x) = \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) \mathrm{d} t}{x} <   G (b) = \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {b} f (t) \mathrm{d} t}{b}
\]
即 \(b\int_{0}^{x}f(t)\mathrm{d}t <   x\int_{0}^{b}f(t)\mathrm{d}t.\)
B 正确.

2000027003.analysis_md:
依题设 \(\lambda y_{1}(x) + \mu y_{2}(x)\) 仍是非齐次微分方程 \(y' + P(x)y = Q(x)\) 的解的充分必要条件是 \(\lambda + \mu = 1\)，求 \(\mathrm{e}^{\lambda^3 + \mu^3}\) 的最小值，只要求 \(\lambda^3 + \mu^3\) 在条件 \(\lambda + \mu = 1\) 下的最小值。由 \(\mu = 1 - \lambda\)，有 \(\lambda^3 + \mu^3 = \lambda^3 + (1 - \lambda)^3 \stackrel{\text{记}}{=} f(\lambda)\)，则
\[
f ^ {\prime} (\lambda) = 3 \lambda^ {2} + 3 (1 - \lambda) ^ {2} \cdot (- 1) = 3 [ \lambda^ {2} - (1 - \lambda) ^ {2} ] = 3 (2 \lambda - 1)
\]
由 \(f^{\prime}(\lambda) = 0\) ，得 \(\lambda = \frac{1}{2}\) ；又 \(f^{\prime \prime}(\lambda) = 6 > 0\) ，知 \(f\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^3 +\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^3 = \frac{1}{4}\) 为 \(\lambda^3 +\mu^3\) 的最小值.C正确.

2000027009.analysis_md:
实对称矩阵 A 与 B 合同的充分必要条件是它们有相同的正、负惯性指数.
由 \(|\lambda E - B| = \left| \begin{array}{ccc}\lambda -1 & 0 & 0\\ 0 & \lambda -1 & -1\\ 0 & -1 & \lambda \end{array} \right| = (\lambda -1)(\lambda^2 -\lambda -1) = 0\)
得 B 的特征值为  \( \lambda_{1}=1>0,\lambda_{2}=\frac{1-\sqrt{5}}{2}<0,\lambda_{3}=\frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}>0. \)
由 \(|\mu E - A| = \left| \begin{array}{ccc}\mu -2 & -1 & 0\\ -1 & \mu -2 & 0\\ 0 & 0 & \mu -a \end{array} \right| = (\mu -a)(\mu -3)(\mu -1) = 0\)
得 A 的特征值为  \( \mu_{1}=a,\mu_{2}=3,\mu_{3}=1 \) .
故 \(a < 0\). B 正确.

2000027004.analysis_md:
对于 D, 有  \( \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty} e^{|x|} \sin x \, dx = \int_{-\infty}^{0} e^{-x} \sin x \, dx + \int_{0}^{+\infty} e^{x} \sin x \, dx \) .
由 \(\int_0^b\mathrm{e}^x\sin x\mathrm{d}x = \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e}^x (\sin x - \cos x)\bigg|_0^b = \frac{1}{2}\left[\mathrm{e}^b (\sin b - \cos b) + 1\right]\)
可知 \(\lim_{b\to +\infty}\int_0^b\mathrm{e}^x\sin x\mathrm{d}x\) 不存在，故 \(\int_0^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^x\sin x\mathrm{d}x\) 发散，从而 \(\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\mathrm{e}^{|x|}\sin x\mathrm{d}x\) 发散.D正确.对于A，由 \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}x^{\frac{7}{2}}\cdot \frac{1}{x^3\sqrt{1 + x}} = 1.\) 根据比较审敛法，知 \(\int_1^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x^3\sqrt{1 + x}}\) 收敛.
对于 B,  \( \int_{0}^{+\infty} x^{2} e^{-x} dx = \Gamma(3) = 2 \) . 故原积分收敛.
对于 C,  \( \int_{2}^{+\infty}\frac{dx}{x\ln^{2}x}=\int_{2}^{+\infty}(\ln x)^{-2}\mathrm{d}(\ln x)=-\frac{1}{\ln x}\bigg|_{2}^{+\infty}=\frac{1}{\ln2} \) ，故原积分收敛.

2000027008.analysis_md:
\(\mathbf{A}_{m\times n}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{b}\) 有解 \(\Leftrightarrow \mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}) = \mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{b})\Leftrightarrow \mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}) = \mathrm{r}\left[(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{b})^{\mathrm{T}}\right] = \mathrm{r}\left[\begin{array}{c}\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\\ \mathbf{b}^{\mathrm{T}}\end{array}\right]\)
\(\Leftrightarrow \mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 与 \(\left[ \begin{array}{c}\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\\ \mathbf{b}^{\mathrm{T}} \end{array} \right]\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 基础解个数相等
因 \(\left[ \begin{array}{c}\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\\ \mathbf{b}^{\mathrm{T}} \end{array} \right]\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 的解必满足 \(\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) ，故 \(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{b}\) 有解 \(\Leftrightarrow \mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 与 \(\left[ \begin{array}{c}\mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{T}}\\ \mathbf{b}^{\mathrm{T}} \end{array} \right]\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 同解. D正确.
对于选项 A, r(A) = m(A 行满秩), 则 r(A) = r(A, b) = m. 故 AX = b 有解; 但 AX = b 有解, 未必有 r(A) = m.
对于选项 B, AX = b 有解  \( \Leftrightarrow r(A) = r(A, b) \) ，但  \( r(A) \)  未必为 n.
对于选项 C, 由前面推导知, AX = b 有解  \( \Leftrightarrow r(A^{T}) = r \begin{bmatrix} A^{T} \\ b^{T} \end{bmatrix} \) , 但秩未必为 m.

2000027005.analysis_md:
由①不能推出 \(f^{\prime}(a)\) 存在, 因为
\(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(a + x^3) - f(a)}{x^2} = \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(a + x^3) - f(a)}{x^3}\cdot x\) 存在，有可能 \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(a + x^3) - f(a)}{x^3}\)
为 \(\infty\) (因 \(\infty \cdot 0\) 型极限可能存在).
由 ②不能推出  \( f'(a) \)  存在.
如 \(f(x) = \begin{cases} x\sin \frac{\pi}{x}, & x \neq 0, \\ 0, & x = 0, \end{cases}\) 则 \(\lim_{\Delta x \to 0} \frac{f(0 + \Delta x) - f(0)}{\Delta x} = \lim_{\Delta x \to 0} \sin \frac{\pi}{\Delta x}\) 不存在，即 \(f'(0)\) 不
存在,但 \( \lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{f\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)-f(0)}{\frac{1}{n}}=\lim_{n\to\infty}\sin n\pi=0. \)
由 ③ 可推出 \( f(x) \) 在 \( x = a \) 处可导.
\[
f ^ {\prime} (a) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow a} \frac {f (x) - f (a)}{x - a} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow a} \frac {(x - a) \varphi (x) - 0}{x - a} = \varphi (a)
\]
由 ④ 可推出  \( f'(a) \)  存在.
由 \(|f(x)| \leqslant L |x - a|^{\alpha}\), 知 \(f(a) = 0\), 且
\[
0 \leqslant \left| \frac {f (x) - f (a)}{x - a} \right| \leqslant L | x - a | ^ {\alpha - 1}, \quad x \in (a - \delta , a + \delta)
\]
因 \(\alpha > 1\)，知 \(\lim_{x \to a} L |x - a|^{\alpha - 1} = 0\). 故由夹逼准则知 \(\lim_{x \to a} \left| \frac{f(x) - f(a)}{x - a} \right| = 0\)，从而
\[
f ^ {\prime} (a) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow a} \frac {f (x) - f (a)}{x - a} = 0
\]
综上所述，D 正确.

2000027010.analysis_md:
由 \(|\mathbf{A}| = 0\) ，知 \(\mathbf{A}^{*}\mathbf{A} = |\mathbf{A}|\mathbf{E} = \mathbf{O}\) ，故
\[
\mathrm{r} (\mathbf {A} ^ {*}) + \mathrm{r} (\mathbf {A}) \leqslant 4
\]
又由 \(A_{11} \neq 0\)，知 \(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{*}) \geqslant 1\)，所以 \(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}) \leqslant 3\). 当 \(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}) < 3\) 时，\(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{*}) = 0\)，与 \(A_{11} \neq 0\) 矛盾.
故 \(\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}) = 3, \mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{*}) = 1\).
由 \(A_{11} = \left| \begin{array}{lll}a_{22} & a_{23} & a_{24}\\ a_{32} & a_{33} & a_{34}\\ a_{42} & a_{43} & a_{44} \end{array} \right|\neq 0\) ，知 \(\left| \begin{array}{ll}a_{22}\\ a_{32}\\ a_{42} \end{array} \right|,\left| \begin{array}{ll}a_{23}\\ a_{33}\\ a_{43} \end{array} \right|,\left| \begin{array}{ll}a_{24}\\ a_{34}\\ a_{44} \end{array} \right|\) 线性无关，故 \(\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\alpha_{4}\) 线性无关，
排除 A.
而  \( \alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3} \)  不一定线性无关, 排除 B、D.
由  \( \mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{*})=1 \)  , 知  \( A^{*}X=0 \)  , 有  \( 4-\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}^{*})=3 \)  个线性无关解.
又由  \( A^{*}A=O \) ，知 A 的列向量  \( \alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\alpha_{4} \)  均是  \( A^{*}X=0 \)  的解，故 C 正确.

\int_ {0} ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {\sqrt {3} x} ^ {x} f (\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}) \mathrm{d} y = - \int_ {\frac {\pi}{4}} ^ {\frac {\pi}{3}} \mathrm{d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {2 \sec \theta} f (r) r \mathrm{d} r

2000027011.analysis_md:
解 令 \(y = 0\) ，得 \(x = -1\) 或 \(x = 0\) ，所求面积为
\[
\begin{array}{l} S = \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} | (x + 1) \left(\mathrm{e} ^ {n x} - 1\right) | \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} (x + 1) \left(1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {n x}\right) \mathrm{d} x \\ = \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} (x + 1) \mathrm{d} x - \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} (x + 1) \mathrm{e} ^ {n x} \mathrm{d} x \\ = \frac {1}{2} (x + 1) ^ {2} \left| _ {- 1} ^ {0} - \frac {1}{n} \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} (x + 1) \mathrm{d} (\mathrm{e} ^ {n x}) \right. \\ = \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{n} \left[ (x + 1) \mathrm{e} ^ {n x} \Big | _ {- 1} ^ {0} - \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} \mathrm{e} ^ {n x} \mathrm{d} x \right] \\ = \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{n} \left(1 - \frac {1}{n} \mathrm{e} ^ {n x} \Big | _ {- 1} ^ {0}\right) = \frac {1}{2} - \frac {1}{n} + \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} (1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- n}) \\ \end{array}
\]

2000027012.analysis_md:
解 \(f(t) = \lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}\frac{t - 1}{[n + (t - 1)i]\sqrt{\frac{t - 1}{n}i}} = \lim_{n\to \infty}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}\frac{t - 1}{n\left(1 + \frac{t - 1}{n}i\right)\sqrt{1 + \frac{t - 1}{n}i} - 1}\)
\[
= \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {\frac {t - 1}{n}}{\left(1 + \frac {t - 1}{n} i\right) \sqrt {1 + \frac {t - 1}{n} i} - 1} = \int_ {1} ^ {t} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x \sqrt {x - 1}}
\]
故 \(\lim_{t\to +\infty}f(t) = \lim_{t\to +\infty}\int_{1}^{t}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x - 1}} = \int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x - 1}} = \int_{1}^{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x - 1}} +\int_{2}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x\sqrt{x - 1}}\)
\[
= \lim _ {\xi \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \int_ {1 + \xi} ^ {2} \frac {2 \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {x - 1})}{1 + (\sqrt {x - 1}) ^ {2}} + \lim _ {b \rightarrow + \infty} \int_ {2} ^ {b} \frac {2 \mathrm{d} (\sqrt {x - 1})}{1 + (\sqrt {x - 1}) ^ {2}}
\]
\[
\begin{array}{l} = \lim _ {\xi \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} 2 \arctan \sqrt {x - 1} \left| _ {1 + \xi} ^ {2} + \lim _ {b \rightarrow + \infty} 2 \arctan \sqrt {x - 1} \right| _ {2} ^ {b} \\ = \lim _ {\xi \rightarrow 0 ^ {+}} \left(\frac {\pi}{2} - 2 \arctan \sqrt {\xi}\right) + \lim _ {b \rightarrow + \infty} 2 \arctan \sqrt {b - 1} - \frac {\pi}{2} \\ = \frac {\pi}{2} - 0 + \pi - \frac {\pi}{2} = \pi \\ \end{array}
\]

2000027013.analysis_md:
已知方程组同时对 \(t\) 求导, 得
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{d} t} = 2 t + 2 \\ \frac {1}{2} \cos y \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} - \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} + 2 t = 0 \end{array} \right.
\]
解得 \(\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t} = 2(t + 1), \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{2t}{1 - \frac{1}{2}\cos y}\), 故 \(\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x} = \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t} \cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}t}{\mathrm{d}x} = \frac{t}{(t + 1)(1 - \frac{1}{2}\cos y)}\).
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} x ^ {2}} = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} t} \left(\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}\right) \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {\left(1 - \frac {1}{2} \cos y\right) ^ {2} - t ^ {2} (t + 1) \sin y}{2 (t + 1) ^ {3} \left(1 - \frac {1}{2} \cos y\right) ^ {3}}
\]
当 \(x = 3\) 时，\(t = 1, y = 0\)，故 \(\frac{\mathrm{d}^2y}{\mathrm{d}x^2}\bigg|_{x=3} = \frac{1}{8}\).

2000027020.analysis_md:
(I) 由复合函数求导法, 有
\[
\begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} \frac {\partial u}{\partial x} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial v} \frac {\partial v}{\partial x} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial v} \\ \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} \frac {\partial u}{\partial y} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial v} \frac {\partial v}{\partial y} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} \left(- y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}\right) + \frac {\partial z}{\partial v} y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} = y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial v} - \frac {\partial z}{\partial u}\right) \\ \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} = \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u ^ {2}} + 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} + \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial v ^ {2}} \\ \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} = \left(- y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}\right) \left[ \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u ^ {2}} \left(- y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}\right) + \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \right] + \frac {1}{2} y ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} + \\ y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \left[ \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} \left(- y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}\right) + \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial v ^ {2}} y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \right] - \frac {1}{2} y ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \frac {\partial z}{\partial v} \\ = y ^ {- 1} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u ^ {2}} - 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} + \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial v ^ {2}}\right) + \frac {1}{2} y ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial u} - \frac {\partial z}{\partial v}\right) \\ \end{array}
\]
故 \(\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x^2} - y\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial y^2} - \frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u^2} + 2\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u\partial v} + \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial v^2} - \left(\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u^2} - 2\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u\partial v} + \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial v^2}\right) -\)
\[
\frac {1}{2} y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial u} - \frac {\partial z}{\partial v}\right) - \frac {1}{2} y ^ {- \frac {1}{2}} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial v} - \frac {\partial z}{\partial u}\right)
\]
\[
= 4 \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} = 1 2 a
\]
所以 \(\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u\partial v} = 3a.\)
(Ⅱ) 由(Ⅰ)知
\[
\frac {\partial f}{\partial u} = \int 3 a \mathrm{d} v + \varphi_ {1} (u) = 3 a v + \varphi_ {1} (u)
\]
由 \(\frac{\partial f(u,0)}{\partial u} = -3u^2\) ，知 \(\varphi_1(u) = -3u^2\)
故 \(\frac{\partial f}{\partial u} = 3av - 3u^2, f(u, v) = \int (3av - 3u^2) \mathrm{d}u + \varphi_2(v) = 3auv - u^3 + \varphi_2(v)\).
由 \(f(0,v) = -v^3\) ，得 \(\varphi_{2}(v) = -v^{3}\) ，则 \(f(u,v) = 3auv - u^3 -v^3\)
由 \( \left\{\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}&=3av-3u^{2}=0,\\ \frac{\partial f}{\partial v}&=3au-3v^{2}=0,\end{aligned}\right. \)  得驻点 \( P_{1}(0,0),P_{2}(a,a). \)
又 \(\frac{\partial^2f}{\partial u^2} = -6u, \frac{\partial^2f}{\partial u\partial v} = 3a, \frac{\partial^2f}{\partial v^2} = -6v.\)
对于 \(P_{1}(0,0), A = 0, B = 3a, C = 0.\)
由 \(AC - B^{2} = -9a^{2} < 0\) ，知 \(f(u,v)\) 在点 \(P_{1}(0,0)\) 处不取得极值.
对于 \(P_{2}(a,a),A = -6a,B = 3a,C = -6a.\)
由 \(AC - B^{2} = (-6a)(-6a) - 9a^{2} = 27a^{2} > 0\)
当 \(a > 0\) 时，\(A = -6a < 0, f(a, a) = a^3\) 为极大值.
当 \(a < 0\) 时，\(A = -6a > 0, f(a, a) = a^3\) 为极小值.

2000027017.analysis_md:
当 \(x \to 0\) 时, \(\sin x^8 \sim x^8\).
原式 \(= \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\int_0^x\mathrm{d}u\int_0^x[u^2 - 3\sin (u - t)^2]\mathrm{d}t}{x^8}\xlongequal{\text{洛必达}}\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\int_0^x[x^2 - 3\sin (x - t)^2]\mathrm{d}t}{8x^7}\)
\[
= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x ^ {3} - 3 \int_ {0} ^ {x} \sin (x - t) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} t}{8 x ^ {7}}
\]

2000027022.analysis_md:

A 有相同的特征值, 为  \( \mu_{1} = \mu_{2} = 1, \mu_{3} = 3 \) , 故
\[
\mathrm{r} (\boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {B}) = \mathrm{r} \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & - b & - 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & - 3 \end{array} \right] = 1
\]
所以 b = -2.
综上所述， \(a = 0,b = -2,c = 3.\)
(Ⅱ) 由 \( (E-A)X=0 \) ，得特征向量  \( \boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1}=(-1,1,0)^{\mathrm{T}},\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2}=(0,0,1)^{\mathrm{T}} \) .

= \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} - 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 1 & 0 \\ \frac {1}{2} & 1 & - \frac {1}{2} \\ - \frac {1}{2} & - 1 & \frac {3}{2} \end{array} \right]

2000028002.analysis_md:
由 \(\lim_{x\to 1^{+}}\frac{x^{2} + 1}{\sqrt{x^{2} - 1}} = +\infty ,\lim_{x\to (-1)^{-}}\frac{x^{2} + 1}{\sqrt{x^{2} - 1}} = +\infty\) ，知 \(x = 1,x = -1\) 是两条铅直渐近线.
由 \(k_{1} = \lim_{x\to -\infty}\frac{y}{x} = \lim_{x\to -\infty}\frac{x^{2} + 1}{x\sqrt{x^{2} - 1}} = -\lim_{x\to -\infty}\frac{1 + \frac{1}{x^{2}}}{\sqrt{1 - \frac{1}{x^{2}}}} = -1\)
\[
b _ {1} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow - \infty} (y - k _ {1} x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow - \infty} \left(\frac {x ^ {2} + 1}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} - 1}} + x\right) = 0
\]

2000028003.analysis_md:
由 \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x^2}{\mathrm{e}^{f(x)} - 1} = 1\) ，知 \(\lim_{x\to 0}\left[\mathrm{e}^{f(x)} - 1\right] = 0\) ，故 \(f(0) = \lim_{x\to 0}f(x) = 0.\)
又由 \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x^2}{\mathrm{e}^{f(x)} - 1} = 1\) ，知 \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x^2}{f(x)} = 1\) ，即 \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x}{f(x) - f(0)} = 1\) ，故
\[
f ^ {\prime} (0) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x) - f (0)}{x} = 0
\]
又 \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x^2}{f(x)} = 1 > 0\) ，根据极限的保号性，存在 \(\delta >0\) ，对 \(\forall x\in (-\delta ,0)\cup (0,\delta)\) ，有 \(\frac{x^2}{f(x)} >0,\) 故 \(f(x) > 0 = f(0)\) .由极值的定义， \(f(0) = 0\) 是 \(f(x)\) 的极小值.C正确.

2000028005.analysis_md:
令 \(g(x) = x\mathrm{e}^x\) ，由已知 \(f(t)\) 是 \(g(x) = t\) 在 \([0, + \infty)\) 上的反函数.
当 \(x \geqslant 0\) 时, \(g'(x) = \mathrm{e}^x + x\mathrm{e}^x > 0\), 且 \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} g(x) = +\infty\), 故 \(f(t)\) 在 \([0, +\infty)\) 上严格单调递增, 从而 \(\lim_{t \to +\infty} f(t) = +\infty\), 故 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} f(n) = +\infty\), \(\{f(n)\}\) 发散.
又 \(\frac{f(n)}{n} = \frac{1}{\mathrm{e}^{f(n)}}\rightarrow 0(n\rightarrow \infty)\) ，知 \(\left\{\frac{f(n)}{n}\right\}\) 收敛，由反函数求导法则，有
\[
f ^ {\prime} (t) = \frac {1}{g ^ {\prime} (x)} \Big | _ {x = f (t)} = \frac {1}{\mathrm{e} ^ {x} + x \mathrm{e} ^ {x}} \Big | _ {x = f (t)} = \frac {1}{\mathrm{e} ^ {f (t)} + f (t) \mathrm{e} ^ {f (t)}}
\]
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {f (n) \mathrm{e} ^ {n}}{n} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {n}}{\mathrm{e} ^ {f (n)}} = \lim _ {t \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {t}}{\mathrm{e} ^ {f (t)}} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {t \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {t}}{\mathrm{e} ^ {f (t)} \cdot f ^ {\prime} (t)} = \lim _ {t \rightarrow + \infty} \mathrm{e} ^ {t} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {f (t)} + f (t) \mathrm{e} ^ {f (t)}}{\mathrm{e} ^ {f (t)}} \\ = \lim _ {t \rightarrow + \infty} \mathrm{e} ^ {t} [ 1 + f (t) ] = + \infty \\ \end{array}
\]
故 \(\left\{\frac{f(n)\mathrm{e}^n}{n}\right\}\) 发散. C 正确.

2000028010.analysis_md:

2000028004.analysis_md:
由 \(x^{2}f(x) = \left[\int x^{2}f(x)\mathrm{d}x\right]^{\prime} = (\arcsin x + C)' = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}}\), 得 \(f(x) = \frac{1}{x^{2}\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}}\).

2000028012.analysis_md:
解方程 由已知,有 \( \frac{dy}{dx}=-\frac{y-\ln x}{x\ln x} \) ,即
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} + \frac {1}{x \ln x} y = \frac {1}{x}
\]
解一阶线性微分方程,得
\[
y = \mathrm{e} ^ {- \int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x \ln x}} \left(\int \frac {1}{x} \mathrm{e} ^ {\int \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x \ln x}} \mathrm{d} x + C\right) = \frac {1}{\ln x} \left[ \int \ln x \mathrm{d} (\ln x) + C \right] = \frac {1}{2} \ln x + \frac {C}{\ln x}
\]
由 \(y(\mathrm{e}) = 1\) ，得 \(C = \frac{1}{2}\) 故 \(y(x) = \frac{1}{2}\ln x + \frac{1}{2\ln x}\)
又由 \( y'(x) = \frac{1}{2x} \cdot \frac{\ln^2 x - 1}{\ln^2 x} = 0 \)，得 \( x = e(x > 1) \)；且当 \( 1 < x < e \) 时，\( y'(x) < 0 \)；当 \( x > e \) 时，\( y'(x) > 0 \).
故 \( y(e) = 1 \) 为 \( y(x) \) 的极小值.

\]
故 \(f(x) \geqslant f(X) + (x - X)(x > X)\), 从而 \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} f(x) = +\infty\).

2000028018.analysis_md:
依题设,如图所示,当圆内切于椭圆时,椭圆上任一点 \( (x,y) \) 到圆心的距离 \( d=\sqrt{x^{2}+(y-1)^{2}} \) 的最小值为圆的半径1,即 \( x^{2}+(y-1)^{2} \) 在条件 \( \frac{2}{3}x^{2}+\frac{2}{9}y^{2}=a^{2} \) 下的最小值为1,求a的值.用拉格朗日乘数法,令
\[
L = x ^ {2} + (y - 1) ^ {2} + \lambda \left(\frac {2}{3} x ^ {2} + \frac {2}{9} y ^ {2} - a ^ {2}\right)
\]
则
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} L _ {x} ^ {\prime} = 2 x + \frac {4}{3} \lambda x = 0 & ① \\ L _ {y} ^ {\prime} = 2 (y - 1) + \frac {4}{9} \lambda y = 0 & ② \\ L _ {\lambda} ^ {\prime} = \frac {2}{3} x ^ {2} + \frac {2}{9} y ^ {2} - a ^ {2} = 0 & ③ \end{array} \right.
\]
由式 ①, 得 \(x = 0\), 或 \(\lambda = -\frac{3}{2}\). 依题设, 切点处 \(x \neq 0\). 将 \(\lambda = -\frac{3}{2}\) 代入式 ②, 得 \(y = \frac{3}{2}\). 将 \(y = \frac{3}{2}\) 代入式 ③, 得 \(x^{2} = \frac{3}{2}\left(a^{2} - \frac{1}{2}\right)\).
将 \(x^{2} = \frac{3}{2}\left(a^{2} - \frac{1}{2}\right), y = \frac{3}{2}\) 同时代入 \(x^{2} + (y - 1)^{2} = 1\)，解得 \(a = 1 (a > 0)\).

2000029001.analysis_md:
将 \(x = 0\) 代入题干方程, 得 \(0 = \int_{1}^{y(0)} \mathrm{e}^{-t^2} \mathrm{d}t\). 由于 \(\mathrm{e}^{-t^2} > 0\), 故 \(y(0) = 1\).
再对方程 \(x = \int_{1}^{x + y}\mathrm{e}^{-t^2}\mathrm{d}t\) 两边关于 \(x\) 求导，得
\[
1 = \mathrm{e} ^ {- (x + y) ^ {2}} (1 + y ^ {\prime}),
\]
即 \(y^{\prime}(x) = \mathrm{e}^{(x + y)^{2}} - 1\) ，代入 \(\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 0,\\ y(0) = 1, \end{array} \right.\) 得 \(y^{\prime}(0) = \mathrm{e} - 1.\) 故
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} y ^ {\frac {1}{x}} = \mathrm{e} ^ {\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln y}{x}} = \mathrm{e} ^ {\lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {y ^ {\prime} (x)}{y (x)}} = \mathrm{e} ^ {\mathrm{e} - 1},
\]
因此选C.

2000028020.analysis_md:
由 \(\mathrm{du}(x, y) = \left[\frac{y^2}{x} + xf\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\right]\mathrm{dx} + \left[y - xf'\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\right]\mathrm{dy}\), 有
\[
\frac {\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac {y ^ {2}}{x} + x f \left(\frac {y}{x}\right), \quad \frac {\partial u}{\partial y} = y - x f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {y}{x}\right)
\]
故 \(\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{2y}{x} +f'\left(\frac{y}{x}\right),\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y\partial x} = \frac{y}{x} f''\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) - f'\left(\frac{y}{x}\right).\)
由已知, \( u(x,y) \) 有二阶连续偏导数,故
\[
\frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial x \partial y} = \frac {\partial^ {2} u}{\partial y \partial x}
\]
即 \(\frac{2y}{x} + f'\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = \frac{y}{x} f''\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) - f'\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\).
令 \(\frac{y}{x} = t\) ，当 \(t = 0\) 时， \(f^{\prime}(t) = 0\) ；当 \(t\neq 0\) 时，有 \(f''(t) - \frac{2}{t} f'(t) = 2\) ，为可降阶微分方程.
令 \( f'(t) = p \)，则 \( p' - \frac{2}{t} p = 2 \)，解得
\[
p = \mathrm{e} ^ {\int \frac {2}{t} \mathrm{d} t} \left(\int 2 \mathrm{e} ^ {- \int \frac {2}{t} \mathrm{d} t} \mathrm{d} t + C _ {1}\right) = C _ {1} t ^ {2} - 2 t
\]
由 \(f^{\prime}(1) = p(1) = 1\) ，得 \(C_1 = 3\)
故 \(f(t) = \int (3t^2 - 2t)\mathrm{d}t + C_2 = t^3 - t^2 + C_2.\)
由 \(f(1) = 1\) ，得 \(C_2 = 1\) ，所以 \(f(t) = t^3 -t^2 +1(t\neq 0)\)
综上所述，有 \(f(t) = t^3 - t^2 + 1\).
令 \( f'(t) = 3t^2 - 2t = 0 \)，得 \( t = 0, t = \frac{2}{3} \). 又
\[
f ^ {\prime \prime} (t) = 6 t - 2
\]
\[
f ^ {\prime \prime} (0) = - 2 <   0, \quad f ^ {\prime \prime} \left(\frac {2}{3}\right) = 2 > 0
\]
故 \(f(0) = 1\) 为极大值，\(f\left(\frac{2}{3}\right) = \frac{23}{27}\) 为极小值.

2000029004.analysis_md:
设 \(F(x) = \ln f(x)\)，则
\[
F ^ {\prime} (x) = \frac {f ^ {\prime} (x)}{f (x)}, F ^ {\prime \prime} (x) = \frac {f (x) f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) - f ^ {\prime 2} (x)}{f ^ {2} (x)}.
\]
由题意知 \(F''(x) > 0\)，即 \(F(x)\) 是 \([0,1]\) 上的凹函数，从而有
\[
\frac {F (0) + F (1)}{2} > F \left(\frac {0 + 1}{2}\right),
\]
即
\[
\frac {\ln f (0) + \ln f (1)}{2} > \ln f \left(\frac {1}{2}\right),
\]
也即
\[
f (0) f (1) > f ^ {2} \left(\frac {1}{2}\right).
\]
所以③正确，④错误.
另一方面,由于 \(F''(x) > 0\), 所以 \(F'(x)\) 在 \((0,1)\) 上单调递增, 从而对任意 \(x \in [0,1]\)
-2
都有
\[
F ^ {\prime} (x) \geqslant F ^ {\prime} (0) = \frac {f ^ {\prime} (0)}{f (0)} = \frac {1}{f (0)} > 0,
\]
因此 \(F(x)\) 单调递增, 故 \(\ln f(1) > \ln f(0)\), 从而 \(f(1) > f(0)\).
所以①正确,②错误.
综上所述,本题选A.

2000029003.analysis_md:
微分方程  \( y' + (\sin x)y = f(x) \)  的通解为
\[
y = \mathrm{e} ^ {- \int \sin x \mathrm{d} x} \left[ \int_ {1} ^ {x} \mathrm{e} ^ {\int \sin t \mathrm{d} t} f (t) \mathrm{d} t + C \right],
\]
即 \(y = \mathrm{e}^{\cos x}\left[\int_{1}^{x}\mathrm{e}^{-\cos t}f(t)\mathrm{d}t + C\right].\)
由 \(y(1) = 0\) ，代入通解得 \(C = 0\) ，因此
\[
y (x) = \mathrm{e} ^ {\cos x} \int_ {1} ^ {x} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \cos t} f (t) \mathrm{d} t.
\]
对于 A 选项, 若  \( f(x) \)  为偶函数, 则  \( \mathrm{e}^{-\cos x}f(x) \)  为偶函数, 但  \( \int_{1}^{x}\mathrm{e}^{-\cos t}f(t)\mathrm{d}t \)  不一定为奇函数. 例如取  \( f(x)=\mathrm{e}^{\cos x} \)  为偶函数, 则  \( \int_{1}^{x}\mathrm{e}^{-\cos t}f(t)\mathrm{d}t=x-1 \)  不是奇函数, 从而  \( y(x)=\mathrm{e}^{\cos x}\int_{1}^{x}\mathrm{e}^{-\cos t}f(t)\mathrm{d}t=\mathrm{e}^{\cos x}(x-1) \)  不是奇函数, A 选项错误.
对于 B 选项, 若  \( y(x) \)  为奇函数, 则  \( y'(x) \)  为偶函数, 于是  \( f(x)=y'+(sin x)y \)  为偶函数, B 选项正确.
对于 C 选项, 取  \( f(x)=\mathrm{e}^{\cos x} \) , 则  \( f(x) \)  有界, 但  \( y(x)=\mathrm{e}^{\cos x}\int_{1}^{x}\mathrm{e}^{-\cos t}f(t)\mathrm{d}t=\mathrm{e}^{\cos x}(x-1) \)  是无界函数, C 选项错误.
对于 D 选项, \( y(x) \) 虽为有界函数,但 \( y'(x) \) 不一定为有界函数,从而 \( f(x)=y'+(\sin x)y \) 不一定为有界函数.例如,取 \( f(x)=2x\sin x^{2}e^{\cos x} \),则

即 \(\Lambda\) 不是满秩矩阵, 所以 0 也是矩阵 \(\Lambda\) 的特征值, 故二次型 \(f\) 在正交变换下的标准形为

\]

2000029014.analysis_md:
令 \(u = x - y + z - t\) ，则
\[
\int_ {x - y} ^ {z} f (x - y + z - t) \mathrm{d} t = \int_ {x - y} ^ {z} f (u) \mathrm{d} u.
\]
将 \(x = 1, y = 0\) 代入 \(\ln (x + y) = \int_{x - y}^{z} f(u) \mathrm{d}u\) 得 \(0 = \int_{1}^{z(1,0)} f(u) \mathrm{d}u\), 又由 \(f\) 非负连续, 所以 \(z(1,0) = 1\).
对 \(\ln (x + y) = \int_{x - y}^{z}f(u)\mathrm{d}u\) 两边分别关于 \(x,y\) 求导，得
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac {1}{x + y} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} f (z) - f (x - y), \\ \frac {1}{x + y} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} f (z) + f (x - y), \end{array} \right.
\]
解得 \(\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{\frac{1}{x + y} + f(x - y)}{f(z)}, \\ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{\frac{1}{x + y} - f(x - y)}{f(z)}, \end{array} \right.\) 于是 \(\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)|_{(1,0)} = \frac{2}{(x + y)f(z)} |_{(1,0)} = 2.\)
故答案填2.

2000029019.analysis_md:
将 \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 4\) 代入 \(x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} - 2xz - 2yz - 1 = 0\) 得 \(z^2 - 2xz - 2yz + 3 = 0\)，故命
\[
L (x, y, z, \lambda , \mu) = z + \lambda (z ^ {2} - 2 x z - 2 y z + 3) + \mu (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} - 4).
\]
令
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l l} L _ {x} ^ {\prime} = - 2 \lambda z + 2 \mu x = 0, & ① \\ L _ {y} ^ {\prime} = - 2 \lambda z + 2 \mu y = 0, & ② \\ L _ {z} ^ {\prime} = 1 + \lambda (2 z - 2 x - 2 y) = 0, & ③ \\ L _ {\lambda} ^ {\prime} = z ^ {2} - 2 x z - 2 y z + 3 = 0, & ④ \\ L _ {\mu} ^ {\prime} = x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} - 4 = 0, & ⑤ \end{array} \right.
\]
①-②得 \((x - y)\mu = 0\) ，故 \(x = y\) 或 \(\mu = 0\)
(1) 若 \(x = y\), 代入⑤得 \(2x^{2} - 4 = 0\), 即 \(x = y = \sqrt{2}\) 或 \(x = y = -\sqrt{2}\).
当 \(x = y = \sqrt{2}\) 时, 代入原方程有 \(z^2 - 4\sqrt{2} z + 3 = 0\), 解得 \(z = 2\sqrt{2} + \sqrt{5}\) 或 \(z = 2\sqrt{2} - \sqrt{5}\); 当 \(x = y = -\sqrt{2}\) 时, 同理解得 \(z = -2\sqrt{2} + \sqrt{5}\) 或 \(z = -2\sqrt{2} - \sqrt{5}\).
(2)若 \(\mu = 0\), 则由①可知 \(\lambda = 0\) 或 \(z = 0\). 若 \(\lambda = 0\), 则③不可能成立, 舍去; 若 \(z = 0\), 则④不可能成立, 舍去.
经比较可知最大值为 \( f(\sqrt{2},\sqrt{2}) = 2\sqrt{2} + \sqrt{5} \)，最小值为 \( f(-\sqrt{2}, - \sqrt{2}) = -2\sqrt{2} - \sqrt{5} \).

2000029021.analysis_md:
(1)由拉格朗日中值定理知存在 \(\xi \in (0, x)\) 使得
\[
\begin{array}{l} g ^ {\prime} (x) = \frac {x f ^ {\prime} (x) - f (x)}{x ^ {2}} = \frac {x f ^ {\prime} (x) - [ f (x) - f (0) ]}{x ^ {2}} \\ = \frac {x f ^ {\prime} (x) - x f ^ {\prime} (\xi)}{x ^ {2}} = \frac {f ^ {\prime} (x) - f ^ {\prime} (\xi)}{x}, \\ \end{array}
\]
由于 \( f''(x)>0 \) ，故 \( f'(x) \) 单调递增，因此 \( f'(x)>f'(\xi) \) ，所以 \( g'(x)>0 \) ，即 \( g(x) \) 在 \( (0,+\infty) \) 上单调递增.
(2)第一步:证明有界性
由于 \(x_0 > x_1 > 0, f'(x) > 0\)，故 \(f(x_1) < f(x_0)\). 又 \(g(x) = \frac{f(x)}{x}\) 单调递增，因此
\[
\begin{array}{l} x _ {2} = x _ {1} - \frac {x _ {1} - x _ {0}}{f (x _ {1}) - f (x _ {0})} f (x _ {1}) = \frac {x _ {0} f (x _ {1}) - x _ {1} f (x _ {0})}{f (x _ {1}) - f (x _ {0})} \\ = \frac {x _ {0} x _ {1}}{f (x _ {1}) - f (x _ {0})} \left[ \frac {f (x _ {1})}{x _ {1}} - \frac {f (x _ {0})}{x _ {0}} \right] > 0, \\ \end{array}
\]
即 \(x_{2} > 0\). 依此类推, 可知 \(x_{n} > 0\), 即数列 \(\{x_{n}\}\) 有下界.
第二步:证明单调性
由于 \(x_{n} > 0, f(0) = 0, f'(x) > 0\)，因此 \(f(x_{n}) > f(0) = 0\) 且 \(\frac{x_n - x_{n-1}}{f(x_n) - f(x_{n-1})} > 0\)，故
\[
x _ {n + 1} = x _ {n} - \frac {x _ {n} - x _ {n - 1}}{f (x _ {n}) - f (x _ {n - 1})} f (x _ {n}) <   x _ {n},
\]
即数列 \(\{x_{n}\}\) 单调递减.
第三步:求极限
由单调有界准则知 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n\) 存在.记 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n = L\) ，对
\[
x _ {n + 1} = x _ {n} - \frac {x _ {n} - x _ {n - 1}}{f (x _ {n}) - f (x _ {n - 1})} f (x _ {n})
\]
两边取极限得
\[
L = L - \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {x _ {n} - x _ {n - 1}}{f (x _ {n}) - f (x _ {n - 1})} f (x _ {n}),
\]
即 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{x_n - x_{n - 1}}{f(x_n) - f(x_{n - 1})} f(x_n) = 0.\)
而由拉格朗日中值定理,存在  \( \xi_{n}\in(x_{n},x_{n-1}) \)  使得
\[
f ^ {\prime} \left(\xi_ {n}\right) = \frac {f \left(x _ {n}\right) - f \left(x _ {n - 1}\right)}{x _ {n} - x _ {n - 1}},
\]
故
\[
\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {x _ {n} - x _ {n - 1}}{f (x _ {n}) - f (x _ {n - 1})} f (x _ {n}) = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {f (x _ {n})}{f ^ {\prime} (\xi_ {n})} = \frac {f (L)}{f ^ {\prime} (L)}.
\]
所以 \(f(L) = 0\) ，从而 \(L = 0\) ，即 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n = 0.\)
(3)由柯西中值定理知,存在  \( \eta_{n}\in(x_{n},x_{n-1}) \) ,使得
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {x _ {n + 1}}{x _ {n} x _ {n - 1}} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {x _ {n} - \frac {x _ {n} - x _ {n - 1}}{f (x _ {n}) - f (x _ {n - 1})} f (x _ {n})}{x _ {n} x _ {n - 1}} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {x _ {n - 1} f (x _ {n}) - x _ {n} f (x _ {n - 1})}{x _ {n} x _ {n - 1} [ f (x _ {n}) - f (x _ {n - 1}) ]} \\ = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {\frac {f (x _ {n})}{x _ {n}} - \frac {f (x _ {n - 1})}{x _ {n - 1}}}{f (x _ {n}) - f (x _ {n - 1})} = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {g (x _ {n}) - g (x _ {n - 1})}{f (x _ {n}) - f (x _ {n - 1})} \\ = \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {g ^ {\prime} (\eta_ {n})}{f ^ {\prime} (\eta_ {n})} = \frac {1}{f ^ {\prime} (0)} \lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} g ^ {\prime} (\eta_ {n}). \\ \end{array}
\]
又
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} g ^ {\prime} (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x f ^ {\prime} (x) - f (x)}{x ^ {2}} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {x f ^ {\prime} (x) - [ f (0) + x f ^ {\prime} (0) + \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (0)}{2} x ^ {2} + o (x ^ {2}) ]}{x ^ {2}} \\ = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {f ^ {\prime} (x) - f ^ {\prime} (0)}{x} - \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (0)}{2} \\ = f ^ {\prime \prime} (0) - \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (0)}{2} = \frac {f ^ {\prime \prime} (0)}{2}. \\ \end{array}
\]
故 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}g'( \eta_n) = \lim_{x\to 0}g'(x) = \frac{f''(0)}{2}.\)
所以 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{x_{n + 1}}{x_nx_{n - 1}} = \frac{1}{f'(0)}\lim_{n\to \infty}g'(\eta_n) = \frac{f''(0)}{2f'(0)}.\)

2000030005.analysis_md:
法一 排除法.
当 \(k = 0\) 时, 微分方程可化为 \(y'' + 4y' = 0\), 通解为 \(C_1 + C_2 e^{-4x}\), 当 \(C_1 \neq 0\) 时, \(\int_0^{+\infty} (C_1 + C_2 e^{-4x}) \mathrm{d}x\) 不收敛, 故排除 A, C.
当  \( k=\frac{3}{2} \)  时，微分方程可化为  \( y''+y'+\frac{3}{2}y=0 \) ，通解为  \( y(x)=\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{1}{2}x}\left(C_{1}\cos\frac{\sqrt{5}}{2}x+C_{2}\sin\frac{\sqrt{5}}{2}x\right) \) ，可得  \( \int_{0}^{+\infty}y(x)\mathrm{d}x \)  收敛，排除 B，故选 D.
法二 \(y'' - (2k - 4)y' + ky = 0\) 的特征方程为 \(r^2 - (2k - 4)r + k = 0\). \(\Delta = (2k - 4)^2 - 4k = 4k^2 - 20k + 16 = 4(k - 1)(k - 4)\).
①当 k<1 或 k>4 时，设特征根为  \( r_{1}, r_{2} \) ，方程的通解  \( y(x)=C_{1}\mathrm{e}^{r_{1}x}+C_{2}\mathrm{e}^{r_{2}x} \) 。此时要使  \( \int_{0}^{+\infty}y(x)\mathrm{d}x \)  收敛，则  \( r_{1}<0, r_{2}<0 \) ，即有  \( \left\{\begin{aligned}r_{1}\cdot r_{2}&=k>0,\\ r_{1}+r_{2}&=2k-4<0,\end{aligned}\right. \)  得 0<k<2，此时 0<k<1。
②当 k=1 时，特征方程为  \( r^{2}+2r+1=0, y(x)=(C_{1}+C_{2}x)e^{-x} \) ，此时  \( \int_{0}^{+\infty} y(x)dx \)  收敛.
③当 k=4 时，特征方程为  \( r^{2}-4r+4=0, y(x)=(C_{1}+C_{2}x)e^{2x} \) ，此时  \( \int_{0}^{+\infty}y(x)dx \)  发散.
④当 1<k<4 时， \( \Delta<0 \) ，特征方程的解为  \( r_{1,2}=k-2\pm\sqrt{(k-1)(4-k)i} \) ，方程的通解  \( y(x)=\mathrm{e}^{(k-2)x}[C_{1}\sin\sqrt{(k-1)(4-k)}x+C_{2}\cos\sqrt{(k-1)(4-k)}x] \) ，要使  \( \int_{0}^{+\infty}y(x)\mathrm{d}x \)  收敛，则有 k-2<0，即 k<2，则 1<k<2。
综上，k 的取值范围为  \( (0,2) \) . 故选 D.

记 \( f(x) \) 在 \( [0,1] \) 上的最小值与最大值分别为m,M,则
\[
m g (x) \leqslant f (x) g (x) \leqslant M g (x), x \in [ 0, 1 ],
\]
于是 \(\int_0^1 mg(x)\mathrm{d}x\leqslant \int_0^1 f(x)g(x)\mathrm{d}x\leqslant \int_0^1 Mg(x)\mathrm{d}x.\)
①当 \(\int_0^1 g(x)\mathrm{d}x = 0\) 时， \(\int_0^1 f(x)g(x)\mathrm{d}x = 0\) ，此时对任意 \(\xi \in (0,1)\) 均有 \(\int_0^1 f(x)g(x)\mathrm{d}x = f(\xi)\int_0^1 g(x)\mathrm{d}x\) 成立.
②当 \(\int_0^1 g(x)\mathrm{d}x > 0\) 时，有 \(m\leqslant \frac{\int_0^1 f(x)g(x)\mathrm{d}x}{\int_0^1 g(x)\mathrm{d}x}\leqslant M\)
a. 当(*)式中等号均不成立时, 由连续函数的介值定理可知, 存在 \(\xi \in (0,1)\), 使得
\[
f (\xi) = \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) g (x) \mathrm{d} x}{\int_ {0} ^ {1} g (x) \mathrm{d} x}.
\]
b. 当(*)式中等号有一个成立时, 不妨令 \(\frac{\int_0^1 f(x) g(x) \mathrm{d}x}{\int_0^1 g(x) \mathrm{d}x} = m\), 又 \(\int_0^1 g(x) \mathrm{d}x > 0\) 且 \(g(x) \geqslant 0\),
并根据 \(\int_0^x g(t)\mathrm{d}t\) 的连续性可知，存在 \(0 < h < 1\) ，使得 \(\int_0^{1 - h}g(x)\mathrm{d}x > 0.\)
若 \(f(x) - m\) 在 \((0,1)\) 内无零点，不妨设 \(f(1) = m\) ，则存在 \(m_0 > 0\) ，使得 \(f(x) - m \geqslant m_0\)
\(x \in (0,1 - h)\), 故
\[
\int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) g (x) \mathrm{d} x - m \int_ {0} ^ {1} g (x) \mathrm{d} x \geqslant \int_ {0} ^ {1 - h} [ f (x) - m ] g (x) \mathrm{d} x \geqslant m _ {0} \int_ {0} ^ {1 - h} g (x) \mathrm{d} x > 0,
\]
与 \(\frac{\int_0^1 f(x)g(x)\mathrm{d}x}{\int_0^1 g(x)\mathrm{d}x} = m\) 矛盾. 故存在 \(\xi \in (0,1)\), 使得 \(f(\xi) = m\).
证毕.
【注】本题有两个要点.
①当出现 \( g(x) \) 仅可积的条件时,不能使用连续函数的介值定理.
②当 \( \int_{0}^{1}g(x)\mathrm{d}x>0 \) 且 \( g(x)\geqslant0 \) 时,令
\[
G (x) = \int_ {0} ^ {x} g (t) \mathrm{d} t, 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1,
\]
则  \( G(x) \)  在  \( [0,1] \)  上连续，且
\[
G (1) > 0, \lim _ {x \rightarrow 1 ^ {-}} G (x) = G (1) > 0,
\]
故存在  \( \delta > 0 \) ，使得当  \( x \in (1 - \delta, 1) \)  时， \( G(x) > 0 \) 。
取 \(x = 1 - h\in (1 - \delta ,1)\)
即有 \(G(1 - h) = \int_{0}^{1 - h}g(x)\mathrm{d}x > 0.\)

2000030021.analysis_md:
(1)【证】由 \(z = z(x - y, x + 2y)\)，有
\[
\frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} + \frac {\partial z}{\partial v}, \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = - \frac {\partial z}{\partial u} + 2 \frac {\partial z}{\partial v},
\]
\[
\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} = \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u ^ {2}} + 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} + \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial v ^ {2}},
\]
\[
\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} = \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u ^ {2}} - 4 \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} + 4 \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial v ^ {2}},
\]
\[
\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} = - \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u ^ {2}} + \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial u \partial v} + 2 \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial v ^ {2}}.
\]
代入原方程得 \(9\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u\partial v} = 3\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\) 即 \(\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial u\partial v} = \frac{1}{3}\cdot \frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\)
(2)【解】将(1)中的结果写成
\[
\frac {\partial}{\partial u} \left(\frac {\partial z}{\partial v}\right) = \frac {1}{3} \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial u},
\]
两边对 \(u\) 积分得
\[
\frac {\partial z}{\partial v} = \frac {1}{3} z + \varphi_ {1} (v).
\]
由题设， \( \frac{\mathrm{d}[z(0,v)]}{\mathrm{d}v}=\frac{1}{3}z(0,v)+\mathrm{e}^{\frac{v}{3}} \) ，故有 \( \varphi_{1}(v)=\mathrm{e}^{\frac{v}{3}} \) ，即 \( z_{v}^{\prime}-\frac{1}{3}z=\mathrm{e}^{\frac{v}{3}} \) ，故
\[
z (u, v) = \mathrm{e} ^ {\frac {v}{3}} \left[ \int \mathrm{e} ^ {\frac {v}{3}} \cdot \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {v}{3}} \mathrm{d} v + C (u) \right] = \mathrm{e} ^ {\frac {v}{3}} \cdot v + \mathrm{e} ^ {\frac {v}{3}} \cdot C (u).
\]
又 \(z(u,0) = 0 + C(u) = \sin u,\)
故 \(z(u,v) = \mathrm{e}^{\frac{v}{3}}(v + \sin u)\)

2000031004.analysis_md:
由于 \(0 < x < 1\)，因此 \(\ln x < 0\)，令 \(\ln x = -t (t > 0)\)，\(x = \mathrm{e}^{-t}\)，有
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{x ^ {p} | \ln x | ^ {q}} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {+ \infty} ^ {0} \frac {- \mathrm{e} ^ {- t}}{\mathrm{e} ^ {- p t} \bullet t ^ {q}} \mathrm{d} t = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {(p - 1) t}}{t ^ {q}} \mathrm{d} t \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {(p - 1) t}}{t ^ {q}} \mathrm{d} t + \int_ {1} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {(p - 1) t}}{t ^ {q}} \mathrm{d} t. \\ \end{array}
\]
对于 \(\int_0^1\frac{\mathrm{e}^{(p - 1)t}}{t^q}\mathrm{d}t\) ，等价于研究 \(\int_0^1\frac{1}{t^q}\mathrm{d}t\) ，故当 \(q < 1\) 时，收敛.
对于 \(\int_{1}^{+\infty}\frac{\mathrm{e}^{(p - 1)t}}{t^q}\mathrm{d}t\) ，当 \(p < 1\) 时，必收敛；
当 \(p = 1\) 时，\(q > 1\) 才能使其收敛，这时 \(\int_0^1\frac{1}{t^q}\mathrm{d}t\) 发散，故 \(p\neq 1\)
当p>1时，必发散.
综上所述，p<1，q<1。

\]
显然 \(\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial y}\) 和 \(\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y\partial x}\) 连续，于是 \(\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y\partial x}\)，故得 \(a = 2, b = 3\)。

\]
故 \(u(x,y) = x^4 y^3 -3xy^2 +5x - 4y + C.\)

2000031018.analysis_md:

\[
y = \mathrm{e} ^ {- \int \frac {1}{x} \mathrm{d} x} \left(\int \frac {1}{x ^ {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {\int \frac {1}{x} \mathrm{d} x} \mathrm{d} x + C\right) = \frac {\ln x + C}{x}.
\]
又 \( y(1)=0 \) ，则C=0，故 \( y=\frac{\ln x}{x} \) .

\[
y ^ {\prime} = \frac {1 - \ln x}{x ^ {2}}, y ^ {\prime \prime} = \frac {2 \ln x - 3}{x ^ {3}}.
\]

又当 \(x > \mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}}\) 时，\(y'' > 0\)；当 \(0 < x < \mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}}\) 时，\(y'' < 0\)。故拐点为 \(\left(\mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}}, \frac{3}{2\mathrm{e}^{\frac{3}{2}}}\right)\)。
由于 \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}\frac{\ln x}{x} = 0\) ，故 \(y = 0\) 为曲线 \(y = y(x)\) 在 \(x\to +\infty\) 时的一条水平渐近线.
由于 \(\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{\ln x}{x} = -\infty\) ，故 \(x = 0\) 为曲线 \(y = y(x)\) 的一条铅直渐近线.

2000031019.analysis_md:
（1）令 \(G(x) = f(x) - \frac{f(c) - f(a)}{c - a} (x - a)\)
则
\[
G (a) = f (a) = G (c),
\]
又 \(G(x)\) 在 \([a, c]\) 上连续，在 \((a, c)\) 内可导，故根据罗尔定理可知，存在 \(\xi \in (a, c)\)，使得 \(G'(\xi) = 0\)，即 \(f'(\xi) = \frac{f(c) - f(a)}{c - a}\)，原命题得证。
(2)由(1)可知，
\[
\begin{array}{l} \frac {f (b) - f (a)}{b - a} = \frac {f (b) - f (c) + f (c) - f (a)}{b - a} \\ = \frac {f (b) - f (c)}{b - c} \cdot \frac {b - c}{b - a} + \frac {f (c) - f (a)}{c - a} \cdot \frac {c - a}{b - a} \\ = f ^ {\prime} (\gamma) \cdot \frac {b - c}{b - a} + f ^ {\prime} (\xi) \cdot \frac {c - a}{b - a}, \\ \end{array}
\]
其中 \(\gamma \in (c, b)\). 令 \(\frac{b - c}{b - a} = t\), 则 \(\frac{c - a}{b - a} = 1 - t, 0 < t < 1\), 故 \(\frac{f(b) - f(a)}{b - a} = tf'(\gamma) + (1 - t)\).

则
\[
\frac {\partial F}{\partial x} = - y f (y - x) - \int_ {0} ^ {y - x} f (t) \mathrm{d} t + x f (y - x) + (y - x) f (y - x) = - \int_ {0} ^ {y - x} f (t) \mathrm{d} t,
\]
\[
\frac {\partial^ {2} F}{\partial x ^ {2}} = f (y - x),
\]
\[

\]

\frac {\partial^ {2} F}{\partial y ^ {2}} = f (y - x),
\]
可得

\[
\begin{array}{l} P = \rho g \int_ {0} ^ {\sin \theta} x (\cos \theta - x \cdot \cot \theta) d x \\ = \rho g \left(\cos \theta \int_ {0} ^ {\sin \theta} x d x - \cot \theta \int_ {0} ^ {\sin \theta} x ^ {2} d x\right) \\ = \frac {1}{6} \rho g \cos \theta \sin^ {2} \theta , \\ \end{array}

2000032003.analysis_md:
对于①,严格来讲,要用定义法证明.
若 \(a = 0\) ，则对任意的 \(\varepsilon >0\) ，存在 \(X > 0\) ，当 \(x > X\) 时， \(\left|f^{\prime}(x)\right| <   \frac{\varepsilon}{2}\)
故结合拉格朗日中值定理, 存在  \( \xi \in (X, x) \) , 有
\[
\begin{array}{l} \left| \frac {f (x)}{x} \right| \leqslant \frac {1}{| x |} [ | f (x) - f (X) | + | f (X) | ] = \frac {| x - X |}{| x |} | f ^ {\prime} (\xi) | + \frac {| f (X) |}{| x |} \\ = \left(1 - \frac {X}{x}\right) | f ^ {\prime} (\xi) | + \frac {| f (X) |}{x} <   1 \cdot \frac {\varepsilon}{2} + \frac {| f (X) |}{x}, \\ \end{array}
\]
当 \( f(X)=0 \) 时，有 \( \left|\frac{f(x)}{x}\right|<\frac{\varepsilon}{2}<\varepsilon. \)
当 \( f(X)\neq0 \) 时，令 \( x_{0}=\max\left\{X,\frac{2|f(X)|}{\varepsilon}\right\} \) ，则当 \( x>x_{0} \) 时， \( \left|\frac{f(x)}{x}\right|<\frac{\varepsilon}{2}+\frac{\varepsilon}{2}=\varepsilon \) .
若 \(a \neq 0\)，令 \(g(x) = f(x) - ax\)，同理可证，故①正确。
对于②, 可举反例, \(f(x) = \sin x\) 可予以否定, 选A.
【注】考试中,考生对①可用广义的洛必达法则,即  \( \lim_{x\to+\infty}\frac{f(x)}{g(x)}\xlongequal{\infty}\lim_{x\to+\infty}\frac{f'(x)}{g'(x)} \)  来验证其成立,但该广义法则不在考试大纲的要求内.

2000032019.analysis_md:
必要性.若对任意 \(x \in (a, b)\) 及适当小的 \(h > 0\), 有
\[
f (x) \leqslant \frac {1}{2} [ f (x + h) + f (x - h) ],
\]
则对上述 \(x\) 及 \(h\) 有
\[
\frac {f (x + h) + f (x - h) - 2 f (x)}{h ^ {2}} \geqslant 0.
\]
两边取极限, 由于 \(f(x)\) 二次可微, 左端极限为
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {h \rightarrow 0} \frac {f (x + h) + f (x - h) - 2 f (x)}{h ^ {2}} = \lim _ {h \rightarrow 0} \frac {f ^ {\prime} (x + h) - f ^ {\prime} (x - h)}{2 h} \\ = \lim _ {h \rightarrow 0} \frac {1}{2} \left[ \frac {f ^ {\prime} (x + h) - f ^ {\prime} (x)}{h} + \frac {f ^ {\prime} (x - h) - f ^ {\prime} (x)}{- h} \right] = f ^ {\prime \prime} (x). \\ \end{array}
\]
因此得 \( f''(x) \geqslant 0, x \in (a, b) \).
充分性.若 \( f''(x)\geqslant0,x\in(a,b) \) ，则 \( f'(x) \) 单调不减，于是对任意的 \( x\in(a,b) \) 及适当小的h>0，有
\[
\begin{array}{l} f (x + h) + f (x - h) - 2 f (x) \\ = \int_ {x} ^ {x + h} [ f ^ {\prime} (t) - f ^ {\prime} (t - h) ] \mathrm{d} t \geqslant 0, \\ \end{array}
\]
即 \( f(x)\leqslant\frac{1}{2}\left[f(x+h)+f(x-h)\right] \) .

2000033002.analysis_md:
当 \(0 \leqslant x \leqslant \frac{\pi}{2}\) 时，
\[
\begin{array}{l} F (x) = \int_ {0} ^ {x} (x - t) \sin t \mathrm{d} t = x \int_ {0} ^ {x} \sin t \mathrm{d} t - \int_ {0} ^ {x} t \sin t \mathrm{d} t \\ = x (- \cos t) \Big | _ {0} ^ {x} + \int_ {0} ^ {x} t \mathrm{d} (\cos t) \\ = x - x \cos x + t \cos t \Big | _ {0} ^ {x} - \int_ {0} ^ {x} \cos t d t \\ = x - \sin x. \\ \end{array}
\]
当 \(x > \frac{\pi}{2}\) 时，
\[
F (x) = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (x - t) \sin t \mathrm{d} t + \int_ {0} ^ {x} (x - t) \cdot 0 \mathrm{d} t = x - 1.
\]
故 \(F(x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}x - \sin x, & 0\leqslant x\leqslant \frac{\pi}{2},\\ x - 1, & x > \frac{\pi}{2}. \end{array} \right.\)
因为
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow \frac {\pi}{2} ^ {-}} F (x) = \frac {\pi}{2} - \sin \frac {\pi}{2} = \frac {\pi}{2} - 1, \lim _ {x \rightarrow \frac {\pi}{2} ^ {+}} F (x) = \frac {\pi}{2} - 1.
\]
且 \(F\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = \frac{\pi}{2} - 1\)，所以 \(F(x)\) 在 \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) 处连续.
而
\[
F _ {-} ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow \frac {\pi}{2} ^ {-}} \frac {F (x) - F \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right)}{x - \frac {\pi}{2}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow \frac {\pi}{2} ^ {-}} \frac {x - \sin x - \frac {\pi}{2} + 1}{x - \frac {\pi}{2} ^ {-}} \stackrel {\text {洛}} {=} \lim _ {x \rightarrow \frac {\pi}{2} ^ {-}} \frac {1 - \cos x}{1} = 1,
\]
\[
F _ {+} ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow \frac {\pi}{2} ^ {+}} \frac {F (x) - F \left(\frac {\pi}{2}\right)}{x - \frac {\pi}{2}} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow \frac {\pi}{2} ^ {+}} \frac {x - 1 - \frac {\pi}{2} + 1}{x - \frac {\pi}{2}} = 1,
\]
所以 \(F^{\prime}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right), F_{+}^{\prime}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) 存在且相等，从而 \(F^{\prime}(0)\) 存在且 \(F^{\prime}(0) = 1\).
综上所述,本题选D.

2000032021.analysis_md:
设曲线 \(\frac{x^2}{4} + y^2 = 1 (x \geqslant 0, y \geqslant 0)\) 上的任意点为 \((x, y)\)，则切线方程为 \(\frac{xX}{4} + yY = 1\)，切线的两个截距分别为 \(X = \frac{4}{x}\)，\(Y = \frac{1}{y}\)。于是线段 \(L\) 的长度平方为
\[
d ^ {2} = \frac {1 6}{x ^ {2}} + \frac {1}{y ^ {2}} = \frac {1 6}{x ^ {2}} + \frac {4}{4 - x ^ {2}}.
\]
记 \( f(x)=d^{2}=\frac{16}{x^{2}}+\frac{4}{4-x^{2}} \) ，则
\[
f ^ {\prime} (x) = \frac {8 (8 - x ^ {2}) (3 x ^ {2} - 8)}{x ^ {3} (4 - x ^ {2}) ^ {2}}.
\]
由此得到区间(0,2)上的唯一驻点 \( x_{0}=\frac{2}{3}\sqrt{6} \) ．由 \( f'(x) \) 的表达式可以看出，在点 \( x_{0} \) 左侧 \( f'(x)<0 \) ，在点 \( x_{0} \) 右侧 \( f'(x)>0 \) ，故 \( f(x) \) 在点 \( x_{0}=\frac{2}{3}\sqrt{6} \) 达到最小值，且
\[
d = \sqrt {f \left(\frac {2}{3} \sqrt {6}\right)} = \sqrt {\frac {1 6}{\frac {8}{3}} + \frac {4}{\frac {4}{3}}} = 3,
\]
切点坐标为 \( \left(\frac{2\sqrt{6}}{3},\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}\right) \) .

故
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {(x, y) \rightarrow (0, 0)} \frac {f (x , y) - f (0 , 0) - f _ {x} ^ {\prime} (0 , 0) x - f _ {y} ^ {\prime} (0 , 0) y}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \\ = \lim _ {(x, y) \rightarrow (0, 0)} \frac {x y + x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} + \alpha \cdot (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2})}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \\ = \lim _ {(x, y) \rightarrow (0, 0)} \frac {x y}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}}, \\ \end{array}
\]
由于 \(0 \leqslant \frac{|xy|}{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}} \leqslant \frac{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}}{2}\), 故由夹逼准则知 \(\lim_{(x,y) \to (0,0)} \frac{xy}{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}} = 0\), 所以 \(f(x,y)\) 在 \((0,0)\) 处可微.
又
\[
f (x, y) = x y + x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} + \alpha (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}) = \frac {(x + y) ^ {2}}{2} + (\frac {1}{2} + \alpha) (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}),
\]
由于 \(\lim_{(x,y)\to (0,0)}\alpha = 0\) ，所以存在点 \((0,0)\) 的去心邻域 \(U_{\delta}(0)\) ，当 \((x,y)\in U_{\delta}(0)\) 时， \(\left|\alpha \right| < \frac{1}{2}\) ，故在 \(U_{\delta}(0)\) 内， \(f(x,y) > 0 = f(0,0)\) .所以 \((0,0)\) 为 \(f(x,y)\) 的极小值点.综上所述，应选B.

2000033006.analysis_md:
对于 A 选项, x=0 是瑕点, 将反常积分拆为两部分
\[
\int_ {- 1} ^ {1} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\arcsin x} = \int_ {- 1} ^ {0} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\arcsin x} + \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\arcsin x} \xlongequal {\text {记作}} I _ {1} + I _ {2}.
\]
当 \(x \to 0^{+}\) 时 \(\arcsin x \sim x\)，所以 \(I_{1}\) 与 \(\int_{-1}^{0} \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x}\) 同敛散，于是 \(I_{1}\) 发散，同理 \(I_{2}\) 也发散，故 \(\int_{-1}^{1} \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\arcsin x}\) 发散.
对于 B 选项, 令 x = cost, 则
\[
\int_ {- 1} ^ {1} \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\arccos x} = \int_ {\pi} ^ {0} \frac {\mathrm{d} (\cos t)}{t} = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \frac {\sin t \mathrm{d} t}{t},
\]
由于 \(\lim_{t\to 0}\frac{\sin t}{t} = 1\) ，故 \(t = 0\) 不是 \(\int_0^\pi \frac{\sin t\mathrm{d}t}{t}\) 的瑕点，这是一个定积分，即 \(\int_{-1}^{1}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\arccos x}\) 收敛.
对于 C 选项, \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) 是瑕点, 当 \(x \to \frac{\pi}{2}^{-}\) 时, \(\ln \sin x \sim \sin x - 1 \sim x - \frac{\pi}{2}\), 所以
\(\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\ln\sin x}\) 与 \(\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x - \frac{\pi}{2}}\) 同敛散，故 \(\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\ln\sin x}\) 发散.
对于D选项， \(x = 0\) 是瑕点，当 \(x\to 0^{+}\) 时， \(\ln \cos x\sim \cos x - 1\sim -\frac{x^2}{2}\) 所以 \(\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\ln\cos x}\) 与 \(\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x^2}\) 同敛散，故 \(\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\ln\cos x}\) 发散.
综上所述,本题选 B.

2000033007.analysis_md:
由 \(\lim_{x\to 0}f(x) = 0\) 知 \(f(x)\) 是 \(x\to 0\) 时的无穷小量，又 \(\left|\sin \frac{1}{x}\right|\leqslant 1\) ，从而
\[
\lim _ {x \to 0} f (x) \sin \frac {1}{x} = 0,
\]
故①是真命题.
对于命题②,取 \( f(x)=\left\{\begin{aligned}k,&\quad x=\frac{1}{k\pi},\\ 0,&\quad \text{其他},\end{aligned}\right. \) 其中k是非零整数,则
(1) 当 \(x = \frac{1}{k\pi}\) 时, \(f(x)\sin \frac{1}{x} = k\sin (k\pi) = 0\);
(2) 当 \(x \neq \frac{1}{k\pi}\) 时, \(f(x)\sin \frac{1}{x} = 0 \cdot \sin \frac{1}{x} = 0\).
因此这个例子满足 \(\lim_{x\to 0}f(x)\sin \frac{1}{x} = 0\) ，但当 \(x\to 0\) 时， \(f(x)\) 的值在0和 \(k\) 之间无限次跳跃，所以 \(\lim_{x\to 0}f(x)\) 不存在，故②是假命题.
对于命题③,仍取 \( f(x)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&k,&x=\frac{1}{k\pi},\\ &0,& 其他,\end{aligned}\right. \) 则 \( f\left(\frac{1}{k\pi}\right)=k \) ,当 \( k\to\infty \) 时, \( f\left(\frac{1}{k\pi}\right)\to\infty \) ,因此 \( f(x) \) 在x=0的去心邻域内无界,但 \( f(x)\sin\frac{1}{x}\equiv0 \) ,故在x=0的去心邻域内 \( f(x)\sin\frac{1}{x} \) 是有界函数,③是假命题.
对于命题④, 假设 \(f(x)\) 在 \(x = 0\) 的去心邻域内有界, 即存在 \(M > 0\), 使得 \(\left|f(x)\right| \leqslant M\), 则
\[
\left| f (x) \sin \frac {1}{x} \right| \leqslant \left| f (x) \right| \leqslant M,
\]
即 \(f(x)\sin \frac{1}{x}\) 在 \(x = 0\) 的去心邻域内有界, 这与条件矛盾, 故假设不成立, 因此 \(f(x)\) 在 \(x = 0\) 的去心邻域内无界, ④是真命题.
综上,所有真命题的序号是①④,应选B.

2000033010.analysis_md:
设二次型 \( f(x_{1},x_{2},x_{3}) \) 对应的二次型矩阵为A,则由题知
\[
Q ^ {\mathrm{T}} A Q = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right).
\]
又因为
\[
P = \left(e _ {1}, - 2 e _ {3}, e _ {2}\right) = \left(e _ {1}, e _ {2}, e _ {3}\right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & - 2 & 0 \end{array} \right) = Q \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & - 2 & 0 \end{array} \right) \xlongequal {\text {记作}} Q C,

所以

P ^ {T} A P = C ^ {T} Q ^ {T} A Q C = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & - 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & - 2 & 0 \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & - 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right).

2000033009.analysis_md:
由  \( \boldsymbol{\beta}=(1,0,1)^{\mathrm{T}} \)  是 Ax=0 的一个基础解系知  \( r(A)=2 \) ，从而  \( \left|A\right|=0, r(A^{*})=1 \) 。又因  \( A^{*}A=\left|A\right|E=O \) ，故 A 的列向量  \( \alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3} \)  均是方程组  \( A^{*}x=0 \)  的解。由  \( r(A)=2 \)  知向量组  \( \alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3} \)  的秩也为 2，则其中 2 个线性无关的向量即为  \( A^{*}x=0 \)  的一个基础解系。
而 \(\beta = (1,0,1)^{\mathrm{T}}\) 是 \(Ax = 0\) 的解，故 \(A\beta = \alpha_{1} + \alpha_{3} = 0\) ，即 \(\alpha_{1},\alpha_{3}\) 线性相关，那么 \(\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}\) 线性无关，从而 \(\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}\) 是 \(A^{*}x = 0\) 的一个基础解系.
另一方面,也有  \( AA^{*}=\left|A\right|E=O \) , 因此  \( A^{*} \)  的列向量也都是 Ax=0 的解. 又  \( \beta \)  是 Ax=0 的一个基础解系, 从而  \( A^{*} \)  的列向量均可由  \( \beta \)  线性表示, 即
\[
\boldsymbol {A} ^ {*} = \left(l _ {1} \boldsymbol {\beta}, l _ {2} \boldsymbol {\beta}, l _ {3} \boldsymbol {\beta}\right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} l _ {1} & l _ {2} & l _ {3} \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ l _ {1} & l _ {2} & l _ {3} \end{array} \right).
\]
又 \(\left(A^{*}\right)^{\mathrm{T}} = \left(A^{\mathrm{T}}\right)^{*} = A^{*}\), 即 \(A^{*}\) 是对称矩阵, 因此 \(A^{*} = \begin{pmatrix} l_{1} & 0 & l_{1} \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ l_{1} & 0 & l_{1} \end{pmatrix}\), 结合 \(A_{11} = l_{1} = 1\) 得 \(A^{*}\)
的表达式为 \(A^{*} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}\), 从而易得 \(A^{*}x = \beta\) 的一个特解为 \((1,0,0)^{\mathrm{T}}\).
综上所述, \(A^{*}x = \beta\) 的通解为 \(x = k_{1}\alpha_{2} + k_{2}\alpha_{3} + (1,0,0)^{\mathrm{T}}\), 其中 \(k_{1}, k_{2}\) 为任意常数, 选 C.

2000033011.analysis_md:
由于 \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}b\cos \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}} = b\) ，因此
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \left[ (a x + b) \cos \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} - x \right] = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} x \left(a \cos \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} - 1\right) + \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} b \cos \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} = 2,
\]
即
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} x \left(a \cos \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} - 1\right) = 2 - b,
\]
所以 \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}\left(a\cos \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}} -1\right) = a - 1 = 0\) ，即 \(a = 1.\) 故
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} x \left(a \cos \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} - 1\right) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} x \left(\cos \frac {1}{\sqrt {x}} - 1\right) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} x \cdot \left(- \frac {1}{2} \frac {1}{x}\right) = - \frac {1}{2},
\]
从而 \(b = 2 - \left(-\frac{1}{2}\right) = \frac{5}{2}\).
故 \(a + b = 1 + \frac{5}{2} = \frac{7}{2}\).

2000033008.analysis_md:
分析选项 A: 一方面, \(ABx = 0\) 的解都是 \(Bx = 0\) 的解; 另一方面, \(Bx = 0\) 的解也都是 \(ABx = 0\) 的解, 从而 \(ABx = 0\) 与 \(Bx = 0\) 同解, 所以 \(r(AB) = r(B)\), A 正确.
分析选项 B: 因为  \( r\left(\begin{array}{c}AB \\ B\end{array}\right)=r\left(\begin{array}{c}O \\ B\end{array}\right)=r(B) \) ，又  \( r(AB)=r(B) \) ，故  \( r(AB)=r(B)=r\left(\begin{array}{c}AB \\ B\end{array}\right) \) ，从而 ABx=0 与 Bx=0 同解，故 ABx=0 的解都是 Bx=0 的解，B 正确.
分析选项 C: 由选项 B 知, 若 \(r(AB) = r(B)\), 则 \(ABx = 0\) 与 \(Bx = 0\) 同解.
对于齐次方程组 \(ABCx = 0\) 与 \(BCx = 0\), 设 \(\alpha\) 是 \(ABCx = 0\) 的解, 即 \(AB(C\alpha) = 0\), 则由 B 选项有 \(B(C\alpha) = 0\), 故 \(ABCx = 0\) 的解都是 \(BCx = 0\) 的解; 而 \(BCx = 0\) 的解又都是 \(ABCx = 0\) 的解. 故 \(ABCx = 0\) 与 \(BCx = 0\) 同解, 从而 \(r(ABC) = r(BC)\), C 正确.
分析选项 D: 取 A = C = O, B = E, 则  \( r(ABC) = r(BC) = 0 \) , 但  \( r(AB) = 0 \neq r(B) = n \) , 故 D 错误.
综上所述,本题选D.

2000033016.analysis_md:
因为  \( \alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3} \)  线性相关, 故
\[
\begin{array}{l} \left| \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} \right| = \left| \begin{array}{c c c} a & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & a & - 1 \\ 1 & - 1 & a \end{array} \right| \xlongequal {r _ {3} - r _ {2}} \left| \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 1 - a ^ {2} & 1 + a \\ 1 & a & - 1 \\ 0 & - 1 - a & a + 1 \end{array} \right| \\ = - \left| \begin{array}{c c} 1 - a ^ {2} & 1 + a \\ - 1 - a & a + 1 \end{array} \right| = (a + 1) ^ {2} (a - 2) = 0, \\ \end{array}
\]
所以 a = -1 或 a = 2.
又
\[
\left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {4}\right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ a & - 1 & 1 \\ - 1 & a & a \end{array} \right) \xrightarrow [ r _ {2} - a r _ {1} ]{r _ {3} + r _ {1}} \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & - 1 - a & 1 - a \\ 0 & a + 1 & a + 1 \end{array} \right)
\]
\[
\xrightarrow [ r _ {2} - r _ {2} ]{r _ {2} \times (- 1)} \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 + a & a - 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 \end{array} \right),
\]
则
①当 \(a = -1\) 时，\(r(\alpha_2, \alpha_3, \alpha_4) = r\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 \end{pmatrix} = r\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix} = 2\)，此时 \(\alpha_2, \alpha_3, \alpha_4\) 线性相关，不符合题意，故 \(a \neq -1\)
②当 \(a = 2\) 时，\(r\left(\alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}, \alpha_{4}\right) = r\left( \begin{array}{ccc}1 & 1 & 1\\ 0 & 3 & 1\\ 0 & 0 & 2 \end{array} \right) = 3\) ，符合题意.
所以 \(a = 2\)

2000033015.analysis_md:

2000033013.analysis_md:
对应于 t=0 的点为  \( (0,1) \) .
对 \(y - t\mathrm{e}^{y} = 1\) 两边关于 \(t\) 求导得
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} - \mathrm{e} ^ {y} - t \mathrm{e} ^ {y} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} = 0,
\]
解得即 \(\frac{\mathrm{dy}}{\mathrm{dt}} = \frac{\mathrm{e}^y}{1 - t\mathrm{e}^y}\). 故由参数方程求导法则可得
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t}}{\frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{d} t}} = \frac {\frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {y}}{1 - t \mathrm{e} ^ {y}}}{\frac {1}{1 + t}} = \frac {\mathrm{e} ^ {y} (1 + t)}{1 - t \mathrm{e} ^ {y}},
\]
所以 \(\frac{\mathrm{dy}}{\mathrm{dx}}\bigg|_{t = 0} = \mathrm{e}.\) 而
\[
\begin{array}{l} \frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} x ^ {2}} = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x} \left(\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}\right) = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} t} \left(\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x}\right) \cdot \frac {1}{\frac {\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{d} t}} \\ = \frac {\left[ \mathrm{e} ^ {y} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} (1 + t) + \mathrm{e} ^ {y} \right] (1 - t \mathrm{e} ^ {y}) - \mathrm{e} ^ {y} (1 + t) (- \mathrm{e} ^ {y} - t \mathrm{e} ^ {y} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t})}{(1 - t \mathrm{e} ^ {y}) ^ {2}} \\ \end{array}
\]
所以 \(\frac{\mathrm{d}^2y}{\mathrm{d}x^2}\bigg|_{t = 0} = 2\mathrm{e}^2 +\mathrm{e}.\)
故曲率
\[
K = \frac {\left| y ^ {\prime \prime} \right|}{\left[ 1 + (y ^ {\prime}) ^ {2} \right] ^ {\frac {3}{2}}} \Bigg | _ {t = 0} = \frac {2 \mathrm{e} ^ {2} + \mathrm{e}}{\left(1 + \mathrm{e} ^ {2}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}}}.
\]

2000033014.analysis_md:
方程 \(x = f(x) + \int_{0}^{\pi - x} f(t) \mathrm{d}t\) 两边同时对 \(x\) 求导得
\[
1 = f ^ {\prime} (x) - f (\pi - x),
\]
再次求导得
\[
0 = f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) + f ^ {\prime} (\pi - x).
\]
又由 \(1 = f'(x) - f(\pi - x)\) 知 \(f'(\pi - x) = f(x) + 1\). 从而
\[
f ^ {\prime \prime} (x) + f (x) = - 1.
\]
此二阶常系数非齐次微分方程对应的齐次方程的特征方程为 \(\lambda^2 + 1 = 0\)，解得 \(\lambda = \pm i\)，故齐次方程的通解为
\[
f _ {1} (x) = C _ {1} \cos x + C _ {2} \sin x,
\]
其中 \(C_1, C_2\) 为任意常数.
又易知 \( f''(x) + f(x) = -1 \) 的一个特解为 \( f_{2}(x) = -1 \)，故此非齐次微分方程通解为
\[
f (x) = C _ {1} \cos x + C _ {2} \sin x - 1.
\]
将 \(x = \pi\) 代入题设方程得 \(f(\pi) = \pi\) ，故
\[
f (\pi) = - C _ {1} + 0 C _ {2} - 1 = - C _ {1} - 1 = \pi ,
\]
解得 \(C_1 = -\pi - 1\).
在 \(1 = f^{\prime}(x) - f(\pi - x)\) 中令 \(x = 0\) 得 \(1 = f^{\prime}(0) - f(\pi) = f^{\prime}(0) - \pi\), 故 \(f^{\prime}(0) = \pi + 1\). 又
\[
f ^ {\prime} (x) = - C _ {1} \sin x + C _ {2} \cos x,
\]
所以 \( f'(0) = C_2 = \pi + 1 \).
将 \(C_1, C_2\) 代入通解整理得
\[
f (x) = (\pi + 1) (\sin x - \cos x) - 1.
\]

2000033017.analysis_md:
(1)由题意, \(L\) 在 \(P(x,y)\) 处的切线斜率为 \(y'\), \(OP\) 的斜率为 \(k = \frac{y}{x}\), 所以
\[
y ^ {\prime} - \frac {y}{x} = 2 x,
\]
根据一阶线性微分方程通解公式有
\[
y = \mathrm{e} ^ {- \int \frac {1}{x} \mathrm{d} x} \left[ \int \mathrm{e} ^ {\int \frac {1}{x} \mathrm{d} x} 2 x \mathrm{d} x + C \right] = x (2 x + C),
\]
代入 \((1,0)\), 解得 \(C = -2\), 故 \(L\) 的方程为
\[
y = 2 x ^ {2} - 2 x.
\]
(2)设直线与 \(L\) 的交点依次为 \(P_{1}(x_{1},y_{1}), P_{2}(x_{2},y_{2})\), 其位置关系如图所示:
![](/uploads/books/1bcc75d8a35b0acde4259aa11dd659c66225b6b44c84fcd693cce363d0e1bb66.jpg)
联立 \(\left\{ \begin{array}{l} y = a(x - \frac{1}{2}) \\ y = 2x^2 - 2x \end{array} \right.\) 有 \(2x^{2} - 2x = a\left(x - \frac{1}{2}\right)\)，整理得
\[

\[
x _ {2} - x _ {1} = \sqrt {\left(x _ {1} + x _ {2}\right) ^ {2} - 4 x _ {1} x _ {2}} = \frac {\sqrt {a ^ {2} + 4}}{2}.
\]
则 \(L\) 与直线所围成图形的面积为
\[
\begin{array}{l} S (a) = \int_ {x _ {1}} ^ {x _ {2}} \left[ a \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) - (2 x ^ {2} - 2 x) \right] \mathrm{d} x = \left(- \frac {2}{3} x ^ {3} + \frac {a + 2}{2} x ^ {2} - \frac {a}{2} x\right) \Bigg | _ {x _ {1}} ^ {x _ {2}} \\ = - \frac {2}{3} \left(x _ {2} ^ {3} - x _ {1} ^ {3}\right) + \frac {a + 2}{2} \left(x _ {2} ^ {2} - x _ {1} ^ {2}\right) - \frac {a}{2} \left(x _ {2} - x _ {1}\right) \\ = \left(x _ {2} - x _ {1}\right) \left[ - \frac {2}{3} \left(x _ {2} ^ {2} + x _ {1} x _ {2} + x _ {1} ^ {2}\right) + \frac {a + 2}{2} \left(x _ {2} + x _ {1}\right) - \frac {a}{2} \right] \\ = \frac {\sqrt {a ^ {2} + 4}}{2} \left[ - \frac {2}{3} \cdot \frac {(a + 2) ^ {2} - a}{4} + \frac {a + 2}{2} \cdot \frac {a + 2}{2} - \frac {a}{2} \right] \\ = \frac {\left(a ^ {2} + 4\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}}}{2 4}. \\ \end{array}
\]
由于 \(\left(a^{2} + 4\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}\) 是关于 \(a^2\) 的增函数, 所以 \(a^2\) 取最小值时 \(S(a)\) 最小, 故 \(a = 0\) 即为所求.

2000033020.analysis_md:

\(\left[(x - 1)^2 + y^2\right] = 1\)；当 \(\left(x - 1\right)^2 + y^2 \geqslant 2\) 时，\(\left[(x - 1)^2 + y^2\right] = 1 = 2\)，但值2仅在两个角点取得，对积分无贡献，可忽略。如图所示：

\iint_ {D} (x + y) ^ {2} [ (x - 1) ^ {2} + y ^ {2} ] \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \iint_ {D _ {1}} (x + y) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \iint_ {D} (x + y) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y - \iint_ {D - D _ {1}} (x + y) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y.
\]
而

\iint_ {D} (x + y) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {1} (x + y) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {2} \left[ \frac {(x + y) ^ {3}}{3} \right] \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{1 2} \left[ (x + 1) ^ {4} - x ^ {4} \right] \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {2} = \frac {1 6}{3}.

\[
\begin{array}{l} \iint_ {D - D _ {1}} (x + y) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \frac {x = 1 + r \cos \theta}{y = r \sin \theta} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \mathrm{d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left(1 + r \cos \theta + r \sin \theta\right) ^ {2} r \mathrm{d} r \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \left[ \frac {3 + \sin 2 \theta}{4} + \frac {2 (\cos \theta + \sin \theta)}{3} \right] d \theta \\ = \left[ \frac {3 \theta}{4} - \frac {\cos 2 \theta}{8} + \frac {2 (\sin \theta - \cos \theta)}{3} \right] \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {\pi} \\ = \frac {3}{4} \pi + \frac {4}{3}. \\ \end{array}

2000033021.analysis_md:
(1)因为 \( f(x) \) 在 \( [0,+\infty) \) 上连续可导,故
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} f (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {x f (x)}{x} \xlongequal {\text {洛必达}} \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {[ f (x) + x f ^ {\prime} (x) ]}{1} = 1.
\]
命 \(g(x) = \mathrm{e}^{-x}f(x)\) ，则 \(g(0) = 0,\lim_{x\to \infty}g(x) = 0.\)
由于 \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}f(x) = 1\) ，故 \(g(x)\) 不恒为0，不妨设存在 \(x_0 > 0\) ，使得 \(f(x_0) > 0\) ，则 \(g(x_0) > 0.\)
由于 \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}g(x) = 0\) ，故由保号性知，存在 \(X > x_0\) ，当 \(x\in (X, + \infty)\) 时， \(g(x) <   g(x_0)\) ，又\(g(0) = 0\) ，所以 \(g(x)\) 在 \((0, + \infty)\) 上的最大值在 \((0,X]\) 上取得.假设在 \(x = \xi\) 处取得，则由费马引理知 \(g^{\prime}(\xi) = 0\) ，即存在 \(\xi \in (0, + \infty)\) ，使得
\[
g ^ {\prime} (\xi) = \mathrm{e} ^ {- \xi} [ f (\xi) - f ^ {\prime} (\xi) ] = 0,
\]
即 \(f(\xi) - f'(\xi) = 0.\)
(2)由(1)知， \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}f(x) = 1\) ，从而
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} x f ^ {\prime} (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} [ f (x) + x f ^ {\prime} (x) ] - \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} f (x) = 0,
\]
则 \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}f'(x) = \lim_{x\to +\infty}\frac{xf'(x)}{x} = 0.\)
命 \(\varphi (x) = \mathrm{e}^{-x}\big[f(x) - f'(x)\big]\) ，则
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \varphi (x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {f (x)}{\mathrm{e} ^ {x}} - \lim _ {x \rightarrow + \infty} \frac {f ^ {\prime} (x)}{\mathrm{e} ^ {x}} = 0,
\]
又由(1)知 \(\varphi (\xi) = 0\) ，所以 \(\varphi (\xi) = \lim_{x\to +\infty}\varphi (x) = 0.\)
类似(1)的证明知 \(\varphi(x)\) 的最值在 \((\xi, +\infty)\) 内取得, 故存在 \(\eta \in (\xi, +\infty) \subset (0, +\infty)\), 使得
\[
\varphi^ {\prime} (\eta) = \mathrm{e} ^ {- \eta} [ f (\eta) - 2 f ^ {\prime} (\eta) + f ^ {\prime \prime} (\eta) ] = 0,
\]
即 \(f(\eta) - 2f'(\eta) + f''(\eta) = 0.\)

2000033018.analysis_md:
(1)由于 \(z > 0\) ，因此由 \(z\cdot \frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\cdot \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\) 得
\[
\frac {z \cdot \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} - \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} \cdot \frac {\partial z}{\partial y}}{z ^ {2}} = 0,
\]
即 \(\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(\frac{\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}}{z}\right) = 0\) ，此方程两边关于 \(y\) 积分得
\[
\frac {\frac {\partial z}{\partial x}}{z} = \varphi (x),
\]
即 \(\frac{\partial(\ln z)}{\partial x} = \varphi (x)\) ，方程两边关于 \(x\) 积分得
\[
\ln z = \int \varphi (x) \mathrm{d} x + g (y) \stackrel {\text {记作}} {=} f (x) + g (y),
\]
因此
\[
z (x, y) = \mathrm{e} ^ {f (x) + g (y)} = \mathrm{e} ^ {f (x)} \cdot \mathrm{e} ^ {g (y)} \xlongequal {\text {记作}} F (x) G (y).
\]
由题意得
\[
z (x, 0) = F (x) \cdot G (0) = x \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2}}{2}}, z (1, y) = F (1) \cdot G (y) = \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1 + y ^ {2}}{2}},
\]
所以
\[
z (x, y) = F (x) G (y) = x \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}{2} - \frac {1}{2}} \cdot \frac {1}{F (1) G (0)} \stackrel {\text {记作}} {=} C x \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}{2}},
\]
再代入 \(z(1,y) = \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{1 + y^2}{2}}\) 解得 \(C = 1\) ，所以 \(z(x,y)\) 的表达式为
\[
z (x, y) = x \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}{2}} (x > 0).
\]
(2) 令
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial z}{\partial x} = (1 - x ^ {2}) \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}{2}} = 0, \\ \frac {\partial z}{\partial y} = - x y \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}{2}} = 0, \end{array} \right.
\]
从第一个方程得 \(x = \pm 1\) ，又 \(x > 0\) ，所以 \(x = 1\) ，代入第二个方程得 \(y = 1\) ，所以唯一可疑极值点为(1,0).
又
\[
\frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} = x \left(x ^ {2} - 3\right) \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}{2}}, \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} = - y \left(1 - x ^ {2}\right) \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}{2}}, \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} = x \left(y ^ {2} - 1\right) \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}{2}},
\]
所以
\[
A = \left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x ^ {2}} \right| _ {(1, 0)} = - 2 \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}, B = \left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial x \partial y} \right| _ {(1, 0)} = 0, C = \left. \frac {\partial^ {2} z}{\partial y ^ {2}} \right| _ {(1, 0)} = - \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2}},
\]
因为 \(AC - B^{2} = 2\mathrm{e}^{-1} > 0\) 且 \(A < 0\), 所以 \((1,0)\) 是极大值点, 极大值为 \(z(1,0) = \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{1}{2}}\).

2000034002.analysis_md: 由题设有 \(\lim_{x\to 0}[f(x) - f'(x)] = f(0) - f'(0) = 0,f'(0) = 0\) ，当 \(x\to 0\) 时，\(\ln (1 + x)\sim x\) ，由此可得 \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x) - f'(x)}{\ln(1 + x)} = \lim_{x\to 0}\left[\frac{f(x) - f(0)}{x} -\frac{f'(x) - f'(0)}{x}\right] =\) \(f^{\prime}(0) - f^{\prime \prime}(0) = -1\Rightarrow f^{\prime \prime}(0) = 1\) ，因此 \(f(0)\) 是 \(f(x)\) 的极小值.所以答案为A.

2000033022.analysis_md:
(1)设特征值1对应的特征向量为 \( x=(x_{1},x_{2},x_{3})^{\mathrm{T}} \) ，则由实对称矩阵不同特征值的特征向量相互正交知 \( x^{T}\xi_{1}=0 \) ，即
\[
x _ {1} + x _ {2} + x _ {3} = 0,
\]
于是可取特征值1的两个线性无关的特征向量为
\[
\xi_ {2} = \left(- 1, 1, 0\right) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \xi_ {3} = \left(1, 1, - 2\right) ^ {\mathrm{T}}.
\]
\(\xi_{1}, \xi_{2}, \xi_{3}\) 已经相互正交，故令
\[
\boldsymbol {P} = \left(\frac {\boldsymbol {\xi} _ {1}}{\left\| \boldsymbol {\xi} _ {1} \right\|}, \frac {\boldsymbol {\xi} _ {2}}{\left\| \boldsymbol {\xi} _ {2} \right\|}, \frac {\boldsymbol {\xi} _ {3}}{\left\| \boldsymbol {\xi} _ {3} \right\|}\right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} & - \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} \\ \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} \\ \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} & 0 & - \frac {2}{\sqrt {6}} \end{array} \right).
\]
则 P 为正交矩阵, 且  \( P^{T}AP=\begin{pmatrix}8&0&0\\0&1&0\\0&0&1\end{pmatrix} \) , 于是
\[
A = P \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 8 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right) P ^ {\mathrm{T}} = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} (2 & 0 & 0) \\ P (0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right] P ^ {\mathrm{T}} \left[ \begin{array}{c} 3 \\ 1 \\ 1 \end{array} \right],
\]
故可取 \(B = P\left( \begin{array}{lll}2 & 0 & 0\\ 0 & 1 & 0\\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right)P^{\mathrm{T}} = \left( \begin{array}{lll}\frac{4}{3} & \frac{1}{3} & \frac{1}{3}\\ \frac{1}{3} & \frac{4}{3} & \frac{1}{3}\\ \frac{1}{3} & \frac{1}{3} & \frac{4}{3} \end{array} \right).\)
(2)由(1)知
\[
P ^ {\mathrm{T}} A P = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 8 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right), P ^ {\mathrm{T}} B P = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right),
\]
故 \(Q = P = \begin{pmatrix} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} & -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{6}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{6}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} & 0 & -\frac{2}{\sqrt{6}} \end{pmatrix}\) 即为所求.
(3)由(2)知,当 \( x\neq0 \) 时,
\[
\frac {x ^ {\mathrm{T}} A x}{x ^ {\mathrm{T}} B x} \frac {x = Q y}{2 y _ {1} ^ {2} + y _ {2} ^ {2} + y _ {3} ^ {2}} \leqslant \frac {4 (2 y _ {1} ^ {2} + y _ {2} ^ {2} + y _ {3} ^ {2})}{2 y _ {1} ^ {2} + y _ {2} ^ {2} + y _ {3} ^ {2}} = 4,
\]
这个最大值 4 是可以取到的.例如,当  \( y_{1}=1, y_{2}=y_{3}=0 \) , 即
\[
\boldsymbol {x} _ {0} = \boldsymbol {Q} \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c} \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} \\ \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} \\ \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} \end{array} \right)
\]
时即有 \(\frac{x_0^{\mathrm{T}}Ax_0}{x_0^{\mathrm{T}}Bx_0} = 4\) ，故 \(\max_{x\neq 0}\frac{x^{\mathrm{T}}Ax}{x^{\mathrm{T}}Bx} = 4.\)

2000034004.analysis_md:
由于 \( (x\sin3x)'=\sin3x+3x\cos3x \) ，于是
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x \sin 3 x) \sin 3 x \mathrm{d} x + 3 \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x \sin 3 x) x \cos 3 x \mathrm{d} x \\ = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x \sin 3 x) \cdot (x \sin 3 x) ^ {\prime} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x \sin 3 x) \mathrm{d} (x \sin 3 x), \\ \end{array}
\]
由于 \(f(x)\) 连续，故 \(f(x)\) 必有原函数，设 \(F'(x) = f(x)\)，则
\[
\int_ {0} ^ {\pi} f (x \sin 3 x) \mathrm{d} (x \sin 3 x) = F (x \sin 3 x) \mid_ {0} ^ {\pi} = 0,
\]
于是 \(1 + 3\int_{0}^{\pi}f(x\sin 3x)x\cos 3x\mathrm{d}x = 0\) ，解得 \(\int_0^\pi f(x\sin 3x)x\cos 3x\mathrm{d}x = -\frac{1}{3}\) 故选A.

2000034003.analysis_md:
解法一 设 \(f(x) = \frac{\ln x}{x^2}, f'(x) = \frac{1 - 2\ln x}{x^3}\), 令 \(f'(x) = 0\) 得 \(x = \sqrt{\mathrm{e}}\).
当 \(0 < x < \sqrt{\mathrm{e}}\) 时，\(f'(x) > 0, f(x)\) 单调递增，且 \(\lim_{x \to 0^{+}} f(x) = -\infty\)；
当 \(x > \sqrt{\mathrm{e}}\) 时，\(f'(x) < 0, f(x)\) 单调递减，且 \(\lim_{x \to +\infty} f(x) = 0\)，故 \(f(x)\) 在 \(x = \sqrt{\mathrm{e}}\) 处取到最大值 \(f(\sqrt{\mathrm{e}}) = \frac{1}{2\mathrm{e}}, k > \frac{1}{2\mathrm{e}}\) 时，两曲线无交点.
解法二 两曲线交点横坐标满足方程 \(kx^{2} - \ln x = 0\) ，令
\[
f (x) = k x ^ {2} - \ln x, f ^ {\prime} (x) = 2 k x - \frac {1}{x} = 0, x = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 k}}, f \left(\frac {1}{\sqrt {2 k}}\right) = \frac {1}{2} + \frac {1}{2} \ln (2 k),
\]
当 \(k > \frac{1}{2e}\) 时有 \(f\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2k}}\right) > 0, \lim_{x \to +\infty} f(x) = +\infty, \lim_{x \to 0^{+}} f(x) = +\infty\)，函数 \(f(x)\) 在区间
\(\left(0, \frac{1}{\sqrt{2k}}\right)\) 上单调递减，在 \(\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2k}}, +\infty\right)\) 上单调递增，因此方程 \(kx^2 - \ln x = 0\) 无实根，即两个曲线没有交点.

2000034001.analysis_md:
由于 \(\lim_{x\to \infty}x\sin \frac{1}{x} = 1\) ，所以 \(y = x\sin \frac{1}{x}\) 有水平渐近线 \(y = 1\) ，没有斜渐近线.
对于曲线  \( y = x \cos \frac{1}{x} \) ,
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} \frac {y}{x} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} \cos \frac {1}{x} = 1, \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} (y - x) = \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} x \left(\cos \frac {1}{x} - 1\right) = - \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} x \cdot \frac {1}{2 x ^ {2}} = - \lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} \frac {1}{2 x} = 0,
\]
所以曲线  \( y = x \cos \frac{1}{x} \)  有斜渐近线 y = x.

因  \( r(A)=3 \) ，故  \( \alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\alpha_{4} \)  存在 3 个线性无关的向量，由  \( \alpha_{1}=\alpha_{3} \) ，知  \( \alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3} \)  和  \( \alpha_{1},\alpha_{3},\alpha_{4} \)  均线性相关，余下的  \( \alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\alpha_{4} \)  和  \( \alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{4} \)  是同一向量组，故  \( \alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\alpha_{4} \)  必线性无关，C 正确.
因为方程组  \( A^{*}x=0 \)  的基础解系含 3 个解向量, 所以 D 不正确.

2000034006.analysis_md:

2000034007.analysis_md:
由 \(\int_0^x t[f(x - t) - \mathrm{e}^{t^2}]\mathrm{d}t = 0\) 得 \(\int_0^x tf(x - t)\mathrm{d}t = \int_0^x t\mathrm{e}^{t^2}\mathrm{d}t.\) 又
\[
\int_ {0} ^ {x} t f (x - t) \mathrm{d} t \xlongequal {x - t = y} \int_ {0} ^ {x} (x - y) f (y) \mathrm{d} y = x \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (y) \mathrm{d} y - \int_ {0} ^ {x} y f (y) \mathrm{d} y,
\]
所以
\[
x \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (y) \mathrm{d} y - \int_ {0} ^ {x} y f (y) \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {x} t \mathrm{e} ^ {t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t.
\]
两边对 \(x\) 求导，得 \(\int_0^x f(y)\mathrm{d}y = x\mathrm{e}^{x^2}\) ，所以
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{d} x \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (x) f (y) \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (y) \mathrm{d} y \right] \mathrm{d} \left(\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (y) \mathrm{d} y\right) \\ = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (y) \mathrm{d} y \right] ^ {2} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {1}{2} \left(x \mathrm{e} ^ {x ^ {2}}\right) ^ {2} \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {1}{2} \mathrm{e} ^ {2}. \\ \end{array}
\]

2000034010.analysis_md:
对于 A, 由于  \( 2p_{2} \)  为 A 的特征值 2 对应的特征向量,  \( 3p_{3} \)  为 A 的特征值 6 对应的特征向量, 因此  \( P=(p_{1},2p_{2},3p_{3}) \)  可使得
\[
\boldsymbol {P} ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {P} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 6 \end{array} \right).
\]
对于 B, 由于  \( p_{1}-p_{2} \)  为 A 的特征值 2 对应的特征向量, 因此  \( \boldsymbol{P}=(p_{1}-p_{2},p_{2},p_{3}) \)  可使得
\[
\boldsymbol {P} ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {P} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 6 \end{array} \right).
\]
对于 C, 由于  \( p_{1}-p_{2}, p_{1}+p_{2} \)  为 A 的特征值 2 对应的线性无关的特征向量, 因此
\[
\boldsymbol {P} = (\boldsymbol {p} _ {1} - \boldsymbol {p} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {1} + \boldsymbol {p} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {3}) \text {可使得} \boldsymbol {P} ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {P} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 & & \\ & 2 & \\ & & 6 \end{array} \right).
\]
对于 D, 由于  \( p_{2} + p_{3} \)  不是 A 的特征值 2 对应的特征向量, 因此
\[
(\boldsymbol {p} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {2} + \boldsymbol {p} _ {3}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {3}) ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {A} (\boldsymbol {p} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {2} + \boldsymbol {p} _ {3}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {3}) \neq \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} 2 & & & \\ & 2 & & \\ & & 6 \end{array} \right).
\]
【注】事实上,如果  \( \boldsymbol{P}=(\boldsymbol{p}_{1},\boldsymbol{p}_{2}+\boldsymbol{p}_{3},\boldsymbol{p}_{3}) \) ,由于
\[
(\boldsymbol {p} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {3}) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \end{array} \right) = (\boldsymbol {p} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {2} + \boldsymbol {p} _ {3}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {3}),
\]
因此
\[
\begin{array}{l} \left(\boldsymbol {p} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {2} + \boldsymbol {p} _ {3}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {3}\right) ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {A} \left(\boldsymbol {p} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {2} + \boldsymbol {p} _ {3}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {3}\right) \\ = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \end{array} \right) ^ {- 1} \left(\boldsymbol {p} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {3}\right) ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {A} \left(\boldsymbol {p} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {p} _ {3}\right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \end{array} \right) \\ = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 & 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 & & \\ & 2 & \\ & & 6 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ & & 1 \end{array} \right) \\ = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & 6 \end{array} \right). \\ \end{array}
\]

2000034014.analysis_md:
① 先求解微分方程 \(x f''(x) = f'(x)\)，该方程为二阶可降阶微分方程，令 \(p = f'(x)\)，则 \(x p' = p, \frac{\mathrm{d}p}{p} = \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{x}\)，解得 \(\ln p = \ln x + \ln C_1\)，所以 \(p = C_1 x\)，即 \(f'(x) = C_1 x\)。由 \(f'(1) = 2\)，得 \(C_1 = 2\)，故 \(f'(x) = 2x, f(x) = x^2 + C_2\)，再由 \(f(1) = 1\)，得 \(C_2 = 0\)，故 \(f(x) = x^2\)。
② 再解 \(xy' + y = x^2\)，变形为 \((xy)' = x^2\)，所求通解为 \(xy = \frac{1}{3} x^3 + C\).

2000034012.analysis_md:
\(\frac{1 - x\sin x}{x(1 + xe^{\cos x})} = \frac{(1 - x\sin x)e^{\cos x}}{xe^{\cos x}(1 + xe^{\cos x})} = (xe^{\cos x})'\left(\frac{1}{xe^{\cos x}} -\frac{1}{1 + xe^{\cos x}}\right)\) ，故
\[
\begin{array}{l} \int \frac {1 - x \sin x}{x (1 + x e ^ {\cos x})} d x = \int (x e ^ {\cos x}) ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {1}{x e ^ {\cos x}} - \frac {1}{1 + x e ^ {\cos x}}\right) d x \\ = \int \frac {\mathrm{d} x \mathrm{e} ^ {\cos x}}{x \mathrm{e} ^ {\cos x}} - \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (1 + x \mathrm{e} ^ {\cos x})}{1 + x \mathrm{e} ^ {\cos x}} \\ = \ln \left| \frac {x \mathrm{e} ^ {\cos x}}{1 + x \mathrm{e} ^ {\cos x}} \right| + C. \\ \end{array}
\]

2000034015.analysis_md:
根据 u 的表达式求偏导可得
\[
\frac {\partial u}{\partial x} = z _ {x} ^ {\prime} \mathrm{e} ^ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \sin \frac {x}{y} + 2 x z \mathrm{e} ^ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \sin \frac {x}{y} + \frac {z}{y} \mathrm{e} ^ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} \cos \frac {x}{y}.
\]
在方程 \(x^{2} + 2y^{2} - z^{2} = 2\) 两边对 \(x\) 求偏导，可得 \(2x - 2z \cdot z_x' = 0\) ，将 \(x = 1, y = 1, z = 1\) 代入，可得 \(z_x' = 1\) 再将 \(x = 1, y = 1, z = 1, z_x' = 1\) 代入，可得 \(\left.\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,1)} = \mathrm{e}^2(3\sin 1 + \cos 1)\).

2000034018.analysis_md:
设曲线在点 \(P(x,y)\) 处的法线方程为
\[
Y - y = - \frac {1}{y ^ {\prime}} (X - x),
\]
它与 \(x\) 轴交点为 \(Q(x + yy', 0)\), 因此 \(PQ\) 长度为 \(y\sqrt{1 + y'^2}\), 由题设有
\[
\frac {y ^ {\prime \prime}}{\sqrt {(1 + y ^ {\prime 2}) ^ {3}}} = \frac {1}{y \sqrt {1 + y ^ {\prime 2}}},
\]
且有初始条件 \( y(0) = 1, y'(0) = 0 \)，上述方程可变化为
\[
y ^ {\prime \prime} = \frac {1 + y ^ {\prime 2}}{y},
\]
令 \( y' = p, y'' = p \frac{dp}{dy} \)，方程可变化为
\[
\frac {p \mathrm{d} p}{1 + p ^ {2}} = \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{y},
\]
积分后可得 \(1 + p^2 = C_1y^2\) ，由 \(y(0) = 1, y'(0) = 0\) 可得 \(C_1 = 1\) ，因此 \(y' = \pm \sqrt{y^2 - 1}\) ，分离变量后可得 \(\frac{\mathrm{dy}}{\sqrt{y^2 - 1}} = \pm \mathrm{dx}\) ，积分后可得
\[
\ln (y + \sqrt {y ^ {2} - 1}) = \pm x + C _ {2}, y (0) = 1, C _ {2} = 0, y + \sqrt {y ^ {2} - 1} = \mathrm{e} ^ {\pm x},
\]
解得
\[
y = \frac {1}{2} (\mathrm{e} ^ {x} + \mathrm{e} ^ {- x}).
\]

2000034017.analysis_md:
(1) \(f^{\prime}(0) = \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{f(x) - f(0)}{x - 0} = \lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x + 2x^2\sin\frac{1}{x}}{x}\)
\[
= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \left(1 + 2 x \sin \frac {1}{x}\right) = 1 + 0 = 1.
\]
当 \(x \neq 0\) 时，\(f'(x) = 1 + 4x \sin \frac{1}{x} - 2\cos \frac{1}{x}\)，故
\[
f ^ {\prime} (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1 + 4 x \sin \frac {1}{x} - 2 \cos \frac {1}{x}, & x \neq 0, \\ 1, & x = 0. \end{array} \right.
\]
当 \(x \neq 0\) 时，\(f'(x)\) 连续.
因为 \(\lim_{x\to 0}f'(x) = \lim_{x\to 0}\left(1 + 4x\sin \frac{1}{x} -2\cos \frac{1}{x}\right)\) 不存在，所以 \(\lim_{x\to 0}f'(x)\neq f'(0),f'(x)\) 在点 \(x = 0\) 处不连续.
(2) \( f'\left(\frac{1}{2k\pi}\right)=1+\frac{2}{k\pi}\sin2k\pi-2\cos2k\pi=-1,k=\pm1,\pm2,\cdots. \)
由于  \( f'(0)=1>0 \) ，所以对任意的  \( \delta>0 \) ， \( f(x) \)  不是  \( (- \delta, \delta) \)  内的单调递减函数.
由于 \(\lim_{k\to \infty}\frac{1}{2k\pi} = 0\) ，所以对任意的 \(\delta >0\) ，总存在非零整数 \(k\) ，有 \(\frac{1}{2k\pi}\in (-\delta ,\delta)\) .又\(f^{\prime}\left(\frac{1}{2k\pi}\right) = -1 <   0\) ，可知 \(f(x)\) 不是 \((- \delta ,\delta)\) 内的单调递增函数.
综上,对任意的  \( \delta > 0, f(x) \)  不是  \( (- \delta, \delta) \)  内的单调函数,故不存在  \( \delta > 0 \) ,使得  \( f(x) \)  在  \( (- \delta, \delta) \)  内单调.
